articleTitle: Impact of the Gain Recovery Time of a QD-SOA on Transmission System Amplification
abstract: We experimentally evaluate the influence of the gain recovery time of a QD-SOA on IM/DD in the O-band and establish a way to estimate the gain recovery time of an SOA.

articleTitle: Extraction of Reflection Coefficient in Silicon Waveguides Using Multiple Reflection Signals in OFDR
abstract: We, for the first time, formulated the behavior of multiple reflections in waveguides with distributed reflections and demonstrated the precise extraction of reflection coefficients in silicon waveguides from OFDR reflection-distance profiles.

articleTitle: Compact, Low Loss, and High-Speed GeSi Quantum-Confined Stark-Effect Electro-Absorption Modulator
abstract: We present 50 GHz O-band GeSi quantum confined stark effect electroabsorption modulators integrated in a 300 mm Si photonics platform with improved integration flow to reduce wafer-scale insertion loss. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Photonic Crystal Microring Resonator on a Hybrid Silicon Nitride-on-Lithium Niobate Platform
abstract: We demonstrate a photonic crystal resonator on hybrid silicon nitride-on-lithium niobate (SiN-on-LN) platform, designed for microwave-assisted optical-frequency conversion applications. We measure a large intrinsic quality factor (Q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">int</inf>) of 1.47×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> with mode-splitting bandwidth of 14.6 GHz.

articleTitle: Constellations to Combat Non-Gaussian PAM4 Noise for SiP Modulators
abstract: The use of amplification with silicon photonics modulators increases the achievable baud rate, but leads to non-Gaussian noise at detection. We use neural networks to optimize the constellations for the asymmetric histograms in detected symbols. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Optical Waveform Transmission with Multiple-Eigenvalue 16-APSK Modulation
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the optical waveform transmission with multiple eigenvalues and parameter optimization, and the transmission of 30-eigenvalue 8-ns soliton pulses with 16-APSK over 200km NZ-DSF has achieved with BER of 5.9E-3.

articleTitle: Design and Characterization of Octave Spanning, 1-THz Kerr Frequency Microcombs in Silicon Nitride
abstract: We design microresonators for octave-spanning soliton frequency comb generation in silicon nitride. We lock the repetition rate via an electro-optic comb and achieve phase noise of -130-dBc/Hz, with the resultant modulated tone tunable over 1-GHz.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Interference Mitigation in Coupled Core Multi-Core Fiber Using Subcarrier Multiplexing
abstract: Nonlinear interference (NLI) is a performance limiting factor for long-haul transmission in coupled-core multi-core fiber (CC-MCF). We propose to use subcarrier multiplexing (SCM) technique to reduce the amount of generated NLI increasing the maximum reachable distance.

articleTitle: Manufacturing $\mathbf{High}-Q$ Silicon Nitride Photonic Chips via Silicon Hardmask Etching
abstract: We present a robust process for fabricating <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{high}-Q$</tex>, dispersion-engineered Si3N4 photonic chips using amorphous silicon hardmask etching with PECVD SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> cladding, achieving an intrinsic quality factor up to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sim 17.5\times 10^{6}$</tex> and an average intrinsic quality factor of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sim 13\times 10^{6}$</tex>. We anticipate a further reduction in propagation loss through LPCVD SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> cladding.

articleTitle: Silicon NEMS Optomechanic Modulator for Multiplexed Recording of Electrophysiological Neural Signals
abstract: We present a novel NEMS Optomechanic modulator on a silicon photonics platform capable of resolving sub-millivolt analog signals, making it suitable for the recording and multiplexing of electrophysiological neural signals.

articleTitle: Photonic Crystal Superpotentials: Realization of Airy Resonances
abstract: We theoretically show that a slowly-varying perturbation to photonic crystal is described using a Schrödinger equation in the vicinity of a quadratic band edge. We use such a ‘superpotential’ to describe photonic crystal Airy resonances.

articleTitle: Approaching Theoretical Performance of 6G Distributed MIMO with Optical Analog Fronthaul
abstract: We experimentally validate coherent joint transmission (CJT) in a D-MIMO system with four transmitters using analog fronthaul and RoF links, fulfilling CJT stringent synchronization requirements. MIMO gains close to theoretical values are demonstrated. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High-Resolution Arrayed-Waveguide-Grating-Assisted Passive Integrated Optical Phased Array for 2-D Beam Steering
abstract: A high-resolution 64-channel arrayed-waveguide-grating-assisted silicon- integrated optical phase array is demonstrated for 2-D beam steering. A field of view of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$5^{\circ}\times 25^{\circ}$</tex> with 0.3° vertical resolution is achieved over a wavelength range of 100 nm with a single optical input. Higher vertical resolution can be attained by utilizing all the inputs of the OPA.

articleTitle: Study on Chaos Synchronization of Cascaded Microresonator Optical Frequency Combs
abstract: By numerically investigating the synchronization of cascaded microresonator frequency combs, we find the optimal transmittance parameters and discover that partial injection from the leader is sufficient. We also present preliminary experimental results. © The Author(s)

articleTitle: $10.2-\mu \mathrm{m}$ Seed Generation in a BGGSe Nonlinear Crystal for Nonlinear Seeding of Terawatt CO2 Amplifiers
abstract: A 3-ps, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$60-\mu \mathrm{J}, 10.2-\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> pulse is generated by mixing subnanosecond 1338-nm and chirped 1540-nm pulses in BGGSe nonlinear crystal. The feasibility of its application in nonlinear seeding of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser amplifiers is proven numerically.

articleTitle: DermaPlex: A Metasurface-Based Hyperspectral Skin Cancer Detection System
abstract: We introduce DermaPlex, a metasurface-based hyperspectral skin cancer detection system. DermaPlex can capture high-resolution hyperspectral images in real-time and is a scalable technology manufactured at a fraction of the cost of conventional hyper-spectral systems.

articleTitle: Optical Nonlinear Dynamics of High-Speed Silicon Microring Modulators
abstract: We present a comprehensive dynamic model for microring modulators, encompassing optical nonlinear and self-heating effects. Our simulation aligns with experiments with different input optical powers, predicting significant bandwidth enhancement for operations exceeding 50 GHz.

articleTitle: Plasmonic Enhancement of Surface Acoustic Wave-Photonic Integrated Devices in Silicon-on-Insulator
abstract: Thermoelastic stimulation of surface acoustic waves in standard silicon photonic circuits is enhanced through the absorption of pump light in surface plasmon resonant unit cells. Transmission losses are reduced by 20 dB.

articleTitle: Quantum Correlations in Multimode Nonlinear Optics
abstract: We develop a framework describing quantum noise propagation in highly spatially multimode nonlinear optical systems. We predict quantum deviations of the spatial intensity noise distribution from the spatial power distribution, and observe this effect experimentally.

articleTitle: Characterization of Passivation Layer Losses Using on-chip Chalcogenide Glass Resonators with Ultra-High Q-Factor in the Mid-Infrared Region
abstract: We optically characterize the absorption loss and surface property of nanometer-thin <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{A}1_{2}\mathrm{O}_{3}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{TiO}_{2}$</tex> passivation layers using chalcogenide glass-based on-chip resonators with ultra-high Q-factor in the mid-IR region.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Pulse Amplification Assisted with Spectral Phase Modulation
abstract: This experiment aimed to improve the pulse shape and the pulse duration, with phase modulation of the seed laser pulse with spatial light modulator before amplifier stage and the employment of Artificial Intelligence algorithms.

articleTitle: Single-Comb Tooth Resolution Direct Frequency Comb Spectroscopy Methods
abstract: A detailed review of the different methods of direct- frequency-comb-spectroscopy with single comb tooth resolution is reported.

articleTitle: Integrated Magnetic Field Camera Based on Infrared Absorption ODMR Mediated by Diamond NV Centers
abstract: Life sciences demand for chip-integrated, fiber-packaged magnetic field cameras to image pulses propagating along nerves. For the first time, we propose and demonstrate such a magnetic field camera employing diamond NV infrared absorption ODMR.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network Assisted Hollow-Core Antiresonant Fiber Design for Supercontinuum Generation
abstract: We investigated the nonlinear Raman-Kerr effect of methane in hollow core antiresonant fibers and used ANNs to correlate fiber geometry to simulated spectra, allowing for the rapid design of supercontinuum-generating optical fibers.

articleTitle: High Efficiency Raman Lasing in Integrated GaN Microresonators
abstract: We demonstrate high efficiency integrated Raman laser based on high-Q GaN microresonators. A threshold pump power of ~21 mW and a slope efficiency of ~44.5% are recorded.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Silicon Photonic Passive Device for Edge Computing
abstract: A silicon photonic passive device which performs nonlinear optical phase-to-amplitude signal conversion is proposed for edge computing applications. Classification of Iris and Wine datasets are demonstrated with accuracy of 100% and 97.75%, respectively. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Beyond Labels: Advancing Single Molecule Sensitivity with Hot Fabry-Perot Micro Cavities
abstract: Fiber-Fabry-Perot microcavities are tools that enhance light-matter interactions. A new detection scheme exploiting photo-thermal effects and Pound-Drever-Hall locking technique enabled label-free detection of solution-phase single biomolecules hundred times smaller than the wavelength in solution phase. © The Author(s)

articleTitle: Coherence-Based Hybrid Simulation Model of Physical and Geometric Optics for Grating-Based Lightguide in Augmented Reality Display
abstract: Coherence-based hybrid simulation model for grating-based lightguide used in AR is proposed. Coherence of overlapping geometric rays during ray tracing is discussed. Our simulation result is closer to experiment result than incoherence-based model. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Entanglement Between a Telecom Photon and a Room-Temperature Atomic-Vapor Quantum Memory
abstract: We report experimental results of entangling a telecom photon and a long-lived atomic quantum memory, a key step in building a quantum repeater for long-distance quantum communications.

articleTitle: All-Optical Nonlinear Activation Functions Based on Parity-Time Phase Transition
abstract: We propose a novel parity-time (PT) symmetric device to generate nonlinear activation for optical computing. By leveraging PT phase transition, our device can realize reconfigurable all-optical activation functions featuring low thresholds and low insertion loss.

articleTitle: Fast and Generalizable Light Field Propagation Modelling in Optical Fiber by Physics-Informed Neural Operator
abstract: An unsupervised physics-informed neural operator is proposed for fast light field propagation modelling in optical fiber of different configurations. The learned PHE-operator obtains accuracy results and shows generalizable performance with lower complexity and running time.

articleTitle: High-Resolution and High-Rate Dual-Comb FMCW Lidar with Coherent Comb Stitching
abstract: A dual-comb FMCW Lidar with coherent comb stitching (CCS) technique is firstly demonstrated. CCS can simultaneously achieve 65 GHz high frequency sweeping range, millimeter-level ranging resolution and 100 kHz high voxel acquisition rate.

articleTitle: An On-Chip Platform for Multi-Degree-of-Freedom Control of Two-Dimensional Quantum and Nonlinear Materials
abstract: We introduce the first on-chip, microelectromechanical system for the in situ tuning of twisted 2D materials, enabling tunable interfacial properties, synthetic topological singularities, and adjustable-polarization light sources for advanced quantum material manipulation in 2D-3D devices.

articleTitle: Sapphire Fiber Scattering Array Interferometer for Multiplexable High-Temperature Sensing
abstract: An intrinsic sapphire fiber scattering array interferometer (SAI) is presented. SAI generates robust interferometric signal with a ~20 dB signal-to-noise ratio and is immune to blackbody radiation-induced noise. Multiplexable high-temperature sensing to ~1500°C is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Terahertz Spectroscopy and Imaging of MOVPE Grown AlGaN Films
abstract: We investigate MOVPE-grown Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.67</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.33</inf>N alloys with varying silicon n-type doping using Terahertz Time-Domain Spectroscopy and Imaging. We observe a compensation regime and spatially inhomogeneous conductivity.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Dynamics of Chiral Phonons in Tungsten Disulfide
abstract: Linearly and circularly polarized phonons in monolayer WS2 are directly excited by resonant infrared pulses. The dynamics of coherent and incoherent chiral phonons are measured by time-resolved Raman spectroscopy and reveal possible depolarization mechanisms.

articleTitle: Gain-Switched-Laser Frequency Comb Self-Injection-Locked to a Microresonator
abstract: A gain-switched-laser frequency comb is self-injection-locked to an electrooptic microresonator. The comb exhibits narrowed linewidth, suppressed frequency instability, and agile frequency control ability.

articleTitle: Scalable Optical Neural Network Based on Parametric Process
abstract: An optical neural network based on parametric process is demonstrated, and DFT is applied to realize a computation frame rate of up to 40MHz. The MNIST-digit dataset classification accuracy is improved to 87.7%.

articleTitle: Purely Quadratic Cavity Solitons in a Nanophotonic Parametric Oscillator
abstract: We experimentally observe signatures of 475-fs-long sech-squared-shaped solitons in a ps-pumped phase-mismatched parametric oscillator in the normal dispersion regime, purely due to cascaded quadratic nonlinearities. The results are in good agreement with our theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Unraveling the Puzzle of the Super-Resolution Imaging by Contact Microspheres
abstract: Theoretical explanation of the super-resolution imaging by contact micro-spheres created a point of attraction during the last decade with many models proposed, but the origin of this effect remains largely elusive. Using a classical double slit, the key factors responsible for this effect are identified by ab initio simulations. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Sub-Diffraction-Limited Multi-Color Multiphoton Imaging with a Single Laser Source and Single Photon Avalanche Detector Array
abstract: We demonstrate sub-diffraction-limited simultaneous two- and three-photon imaging, using a high-power ultrafast fiber laser and single-photon avalanche detector array. Despite the 3-times longer excitation wavelength, our demonstration outperforms standard confocal microscopy of the same samples.

articleTitle: Assessment of Pulpal Blood Flow with Optical Coherence Tomography Signal Speckle Analysis
abstract: This study employed speckle autocorrelation analysis in Optical Coherence Tomography signals to assess ex vivo pulpal blood flow. Results suggest OCT's potential as a non-invasive diagnostic tool for pulp vitality and microcirculation monitoring.

articleTitle: A Giant Interferometric Fiber Optic Gyroscope with Low Self-Noise for Geophysical Rotation Sensing
abstract: A low Self-noise giant interferometric fiber optic gyroscope system has been built for geophysical rotation sensing. The gyroscope 24-hour stability test shows that sensitivity can reach 1.65×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup> rad/s <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\checkmark$</tex> Hz.

articleTitle: Quantum Inertial Sensors for Field Applications
abstract: Cold atom quantum sensors have now left laboratories. We have operated several gravimeters in field conditions, for example on a volcano, and are working on next generation onboard devices for geophysics and inertial navigation.

articleTitle: An Effective Countermeasure Against Time-Shift Attack Using a Combination of Passive Quenched and Gated Detectors
abstract: We have devised an effective countermeasure against time-shift attack in quantum key distribution. The attack is completely neutralized by combining passive quenched and gated detectors, resulting in a threefold improvement in the transmission distance.

articleTitle: A High-Efficiency Terahertz Sensor Based on Surface Lattice Resonance Metasurface for Biochemical Detection
abstract: We propose a novel terahertz sensor based on surface lattice resonance metasurface with high sensitivity (502.8GHz/RIU), and simple structure design. In addition, the resonance frequency and sensitivity can be controlled regularly by adjusting the period.

articleTitle: Cavity Continuum
abstract: We demonstrate large arrays of coupled whispering gallery resonators formed by droplets. Employing fluorescent mapping, we measure the spatial and spectral distribution of light intensity across the modes within this cavity ensemble. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High-Accuracy Simultaneous Measurement of Spectrum and Full-Stokes Polarization Based on Speckle Pattern
abstract: The computational spectropolarimeter is demonstrated for the first time using speckle patterns obtained from a multi-mode fiber, with 100-pm spectral resolution, 30-nm bandwidth and a polarization measurement error of 5.3x10<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</inf>.

articleTitle: 4D FMCW LiDAR System with Compact Spectral-Scanning Structure and High Angular Resolution
abstract: We develop a spectral-scanning FMCW LiDAR system achieving simultaneous 3D imaging and velocity measurement using a grating-rotator set. A FoV of 16.2°x4.73°and an angular resolution of 0.1 00x 0.059<are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Multimode Fibre Imaging Resilience to Deformation in the Near-Field and Far-Field
abstract: Multimode fibres exhibit degraded imaging performance when the fibre bends. We contrast the spatial variation of the imaging performance due to bending between imaging in the near and far-field of the output facet.

articleTitle: An Integrated Cavity Soliton Based Terahertz Voltage-Controlled Oscillator
abstract: Kerr-induced synchronization enables direct control of a soliton microcomb's repetition rate by a reference laser's frequency. We demonstrate that dynamically tuning this frequency creates a coherent RF-to-THz optical link, resulting in a voltage-controlled THz oscillator. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High Gain Squeezing in Resonators: Beyond Lorentzian Enhancement
abstract: We introduce a novel method for modelling squeezed light generation in mi-croring systems beyond the perturbative regime, without necessitating a Lorentzian resonance structure. As such, this method is applicable within broad ranges of finesse.

articleTitle: Characterization of Quantum Cascade Laser Facets via Steady-State Thermoreflectance
abstract: We investigate the use of steady-state thermoreflectance as a hitherto unexplored method of QCL evaluation via material characterization of the material thermal conductivity. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach for quantitative thermal characterization of post-fabrication QCL epitaxy at the sub-micron scale.

articleTitle: Enhanced Stability in RF Transmission for Star Topology Fiber Optic Networks
abstract: We characterize a star topology fiber optic network frequency transmission system. The achieved frequency transmission instability is 3.3 × 10–<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</sup> @ 1 s within a 103 km fiber optic link in point-to-multipoint experiments.

articleTitle: Self-Focusing in Nonlinear Hatano-Nelson Lattices
abstract: We probe the interplay between Kerr nonlinearity and non-Hermiticity of a Hatano-Nelson lattice in the context of non-Hermitian photonics. In particular, we examine the relation between self-focusing and the skin effect under single-channel excitation. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: New Single Photon Source Device Concept Based on GaAs Nano-Ridge Engineering on Silicon
abstract: InAs quantum dots embedded in GaAs are a popular choice for the development of single photon sources. Nano-ridge engineering provides a route to monolithically integrate such sources on the silicon photonics platform.

articleTitle: A 10 MHz Repetition Rate Er:Fiber Laser Frequency Comb
abstract: We present a low-noise Er:fiber laser frequency comb at 10 MHz repetition rate. Self-referencing with nanophotonic lithium niobate waveguides requires only 3 mW of optical power and electrical power of 540 mW.

articleTitle: Network-Ready Source of Indistinguishable Single Photons
abstract: We demonstrate a source of transform-limited indistinguishable photons in telecom band synchronized to the external clock. We observe near-perfect indistinguisha-bility and sub-picosecond synchronization timing jitter. This network-compatible source enables large-scale, multi-node practical quantum networks.

articleTitle: Doppler Spectroscopy of Intracellular Dynamics Detects Pathogenic Infection and Antibiotic Resistance
abstract: Doppler spectroscopy detects signatures of bacterial infection of in vitro tissue and can monitor their suppression upon antibiotic use. Such early detection may allow quick diagnosis and selection of effective therapy for patients.

articleTitle: Influence of Heat Accumulation in the Laser Treatment Area on the Dynamics of LIPSS Formation for Pure Titanium and Titanium Alloy
abstract: The dependences of LSFL period and the types of large LIPSS for pure titanium and titanium alloy on the amount of heat accumulation in the treatment area by a picosecond laser are presented.

articleTitle: An Ultra-broadband Approach for Breath Analysis
abstract: We present a breath analysis system using an intrapulse difference frequency generation-based (IDFG-based) supercontinuum source in the 2 – 11.5 µm wavelength range for simultaneous detection of metabolites in exhaled breath using Fourier transform spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Implementing the Geometric Phase for Designing the Axially Asymmetric Metasurface Element
abstract: Designing a metasurface with appropriate phase correlation between light's linear and circular polarization states is challenging. The focus here is obtaining the geometric phases from different geometric shapes for optimum dielectric metasurface design.

articleTitle: Active Nonlinear Mid-infrared Photonics
abstract: Our DC-driven semiconductor laser chip generates one picosecond solitons at 8.3 μm, using active nonlinear resonators. It integrates all components (pump, resonator, filter), enabling turnkey, background-free bright pulse generation with immediate applications in nonlinear mid-infrared photonics. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultra-Compact, Tunable Photon Pair Source for Pulsed Temporal-Mode Encoding
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of pulsed temporal-mode encoding quantum states via spontaneous four-wave mixing using two micro-ring resonators on the silicon-on-insulator (SOI) platform. The output is tunable between separable states and two-dimensional entangled states. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Monolithic Barium Titanate Modulators on Silion-on-Insulator Substrates
abstract: We demonstrate monolithic Barium Titanate (BTO) - based Mach - Zehnder Interferometers (MZIs) in thin film epitaxial BTO RF-sputtered on silicon-on-insulator sub-strates. A <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$V_{\pi}L=2.32\mathrm{V}.cm$</tex> is reported corresponding to an effective Pockels coefficient of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$r_{eff}=89$</tex> pm/V in our BTO. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: One-sided Slotted Photonic Crystal Nanofiber for Cavity QED
abstract: A one-sided slotted photonic crystal cavity structure on an optical nanofiber is proposed to realize cavity quantum electrodynamics. The device can unidirectionally couple single photons with an efficiency of ∼90% into the nanofiber fundamental mode.

articleTitle: Satellite Radio Detection via Dual-Microwave Rydberg Spectroscopy
abstract: We present a resonant Rydberg electric field sensor o perating in t he UHF band using a dual-optical-dual-microwave spectroscopy scheme. We measure Sirius XM satellite radio, and compare the sensitivity to other contemporary implementations of the technology.

articleTitle: Moiré Excitons Confined by Twisted hBN Substrates
abstract: We demonstrate a new approach to confining excitons in a MoSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> monolayer via the electrostatic potential from a twisted hBN substrate, which offers more flexibility in controlling exciton properties in a moiré superlattice. © The Author(s)

articleTitle: Free-Electron Cluster States
abstract: We propose cluster states based on entangled free-electrons, controlled via free-electron interactions with ancilla qubits stored in photonic cavities or Josephson junctions, providing a novel resource for quantum electron microscopy and for measurement-based quantum simulations.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic Physical Unclonable Functions Based on an Actively-Tuned Waveguide Array
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally physical unclonable functions based on an 8-channel waveguide array with embedded phase shifters to actively generate challenge-response pairs. We generate 128 challenges and show unclonability between 6 copies on the same wafer.

articleTitle: Strict Verification of Multiple Indefinite Causal Orders on a Programmable Silicon-Photonic Quantum Chip
abstract: We report strict verification of multiple types of indefinite causal orders and demonstrate distillation of indefinite causal order utilizing a programmable silicon-photonic quantum chip. This experimental implementation contributes to the development of a resource theory for indefinite causal order.

articleTitle: Chirped Solitary Wave Solutions for Optical Frequency Comb Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that the interplay of higher-order dispersion and nonlinear ef-fects excites propagation of ultrashort, nonlinearly-chirped signals in an optical fiber. These undamped excitations reproduce characteristics of Kerr-comb systems, including bright-solitons and periodic wavetrains. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Impact of Mechanical Strain on Auger Recombination in InGaAs/InP
abstract: We characterized the impact of mechanically-applied biaxial strain on Auger recombination in InGaAs quantum wells using time-resolved photoluminescence. Our results support that Auger recombination is reduced by mechanical distortion introduced by strained-layer epitaxy. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Efficient Photoconductive Switches on GaN for THz Generation
abstract: We demonstrate efficient generation of THz pulses (>10 pJ and >30% efficiency) in GaN photoconductive switches coupled to a strip-line waveguide. We employ a quadratic electrooptic effect of excitonic origin to probe the THz pulses.

articleTitle: Attosecond Electron Microscopy Using Free-Electron Homodyne Detection
abstract: We implement attosecond electron microscopy in a TEM to measure the optical near-field of a plasmonic nanoprism with 54 as (FWHM) temporal and few-nm spatial resolution, demonstrating free-electron homodyne detection.

articleTitle: Virtual Histological Staining of Label-Free Autopsy Tissue Sections via Deep Learning
abstract: We present deep learning-based virtual staining of label-free autopsy tissue sections, eliminating severe autolysis-induced artifacts caused by delayed fixation inherent in traditional histochemical H&E staining.

articleTitle: Mode-Resolved Direct Frequency Comb Cavity Ring-Down Spectroscopy using an Interband Cascade Laser
abstract: We demonstrate a mid-infrared mode-resolved direct frequency comb CRDS with a 3.27µm interband cascade laser. Absorption for each comb line is extracted during cavity scanning. The compact design achieves a 1.7 km equivalent pathlength, showcasing sensitivity surpassing 4x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-7</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>

articleTitle: Mid-Infrared Cross-Comb Spectroscopy with a Single-Cavity Dual-Comb OPO Operating at 250 MHz
abstract: We demonstrate high-resolution spectroscopy by using a tunable 250-MHz OPO cavity as a transceiver for mid-infrared cross-comb spectroscopy. In a 2-s-long coherently-averaged measurement at 3.1 μm we obtain a high spectral signal-to-noise ratio of 42 dB. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Wide-Angle Diffraction-Limited Quadratic Metalens
abstract: We successfully demonstrated an aberration-free wide-angle metalens with a numerical aperture of 0.24 at a wavelength of 450 nm. The metalens were verified by experiment to achieve a diffraction-limited focusing under the angle of incidence from 0 to 17.5 degrees.

articleTitle: Quantum Enhanced Mechanical Rotation Sensing using Wavefront Photonic Gears
abstract: We demonstrate a compact and efficient rotation sensing mechanism that uses structured light and is enhanced by bright N00N states. It uses two opposite spiral phase plates that convert mechanical rotation to wavefront phase shifts.

articleTitle: High-Brightness Laser-Driven Light Source (LDLS®) with Manipulated Spectral Output to Facilitate UV Applications
abstract: A high-brightness LDLS with manipulated spectral output is proposed and evaluated. Its design principle, features, radiance, and stability are presented alongside a comparison with a 30W deuterium light source.

articleTitle: Lithium Tantalate Photonic Integrated Circuits for High Volume Manufacturing
abstract: We demonstrate the first photonic integrated circuit platform using Lithium Tantalate <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\text{LiTaO}_{3})$</tex>, achieving waveguides with low losses (5.6 dB m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>), Mach-Zehnder modulators with a 40 GHz electro-optical bandwidth and a 1.96 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{V}\cdot \text{cm}$</tex> voltage-length product, along with microresonators supporting dissipative Kerr soliton generation. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Design and Performance of a Multi-mode Photon-counting Receiver for the NASA Orion Artemis II Optical Communications System
abstract: A multi-mode photon-counting optical receiver was designed and tested for the NASA Orion Artemis II Optical Communications System downlink. The receiver achieved error-free communications from 20 Mb/s to 267 Mb/s with single-photon-level sensitivity.

articleTitle: Controlling High Harmonic Supercontinuum Generation with the Spectral Polarization of the Driver
abstract: A High-Harmonic-Generation (HHG) scheme offering continuous control over the bandwidth of the spectral peaks is presented. The scheme uses a vectorial two-color driver with close frequencies, generated by spectrally splitting an input laser pulse and recombining the two halves after their polarizations are made cross-elliptical counter-rotating.

articleTitle: A Single-Celled Design Approach for Tri-Channel Metalenses
abstract: We present a non-interleaved single-celled design approach for tri-channel metalenses. We encode each meta-atom with three independent phase responses to generate three different spin-selective metalenses, which enables multi-functional meta-device.

articleTitle: Significant Increase of Performances of a kHz Laser-Plasma Accelerator Using a $H_{2}$ Plasma
abstract: By using a Hydrogen plasma, we significantly increased the performances of our kHz laser-plasma accelerator. We achieved excellent level of stability both on the spectrum and the spatial profile of the electron beam.

articleTitle: MEMS-based Metasurfaces for a Dynamic OAM-Gaussian Switching Fiber Laser
abstract: We introduce a dynamic fiber laser with an intracavity electrically-driven MEMS metasurface for efficient and rapid switching between complex vortex and simple Gaussian beam modes at 1030 nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Single-Microresonator-Based Dynamic Photonic Molecule Switch
abstract: We propose a dynamic on-chip photonic molecule switch in an ultra-compact multimode silicon microring, allowing for flexible either nonlinear control or loss reduction. This strategy leads to a record low-loss transition (Qi ~ 10 million) under hundred-GHz FSR level.

articleTitle: Controlling Steady-State Statistics of a Bistable Driven-Dissipative System with Quantum Bias
abstract: We investigate the dynamics of optical parametric oscillators biased with quantum states of light and present a method for single-quadrature reconstruction of their Husimi <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Q-\text{function}$</tex>. Perfect reconstruction fidelity is predicted at specific threshold values.

articleTitle: On Scalability of Static 940 nm VCSEL Arrays
abstract: Static light-current-voltage (LIV) curves, spectrum, and far-field o f oxide-confined 7,19,100, and 312 vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (VCSEL) arrays centered at 940 nm were collected to quantify scalability limits set by thermal coupling.

articleTitle: Sub-Nanometer-Confined Optical Field in a Nanoslit Waveguiding Mode
abstract: By near-field coupling between a single nanowire (SNW) and a coupled nanowire pair (CNP), we demonstrate a new method to generate a sub-nanometer-confined optical field <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\sim 0.3\times 3.1\ \text{nm}^{2})$</tex> in a nanoslit waveguiding mode at 550-nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Widely Separated Tunable Optical Parametric Oscillation in GaN Microresonators
abstract: Widely separated tunable optical parametric oscillation (OPO) is demonstrated in GaN microresonators with specially designed waveguide for phase-matching. OPO frequency separation up to 96.6 THz with a tuning range of 20 THz is recorded.

articleTitle: Distributed Vibration Sensing and Simultaneous Self-Homodyne Coherent Transmission of Single-Carrier Net 5.36 Tbps Signal Using 7-Core Fiber
abstract: We demonstrate a self-homodyne coherent transmission system with integrated laser interferometry based on a weakly-coupled 7-core fiber. We achieve multi-parameter vibration sensing and simultaneous transmission of single-carrier net 5.36 Tbps signals over 41.4 km.

articleTitle: In-Situ Metrology Interferometric Set-Up for the Diagnosis and Analysis of Coherent Beam Combining Lasers
abstract: We present a new compact Pistil interferometer, specifically designed for easy integration on all CBC lasers. This demonstrator enables self-referenced and accurate measurements of the near-field phase, whatever the set-point applied.

articleTitle: On the Effect of Spatial Misalignment Analysis on Spatial Light Modulator-Based Spatial Multiplexing in Multimode Fibres
abstract: We investigate the performance of mode selectivity telescopic free space optical system with spatial misalignment and the effect of misfocus in utilized lenses in the system. The alignment requirements for minimal mode crosstalk are quantified.

articleTitle: Supermode-Dependent Modulation Instability in Dual-Core Fiber Cavities
abstract: This work explores nonlinear dynamics in dual-core fiber resonators by means of two coupled Lugiato-Lefever equations uncovering peculiar bistability features and supermode dependent modulation instability gain.

articleTitle: Integrated Coherent Photonic Crossbar Arrays for Efficient Optical Computing
abstract: We present a scalable approach to optical computing using coherent crossbar arrays for processing temporally multiplexed signals. Our design enables scalable matrix -matrix operations, and correlation detection, enabling efficient on -chip optical computing for diverse AI applications.

articleTitle: Enhancing Coherent Super-Oscillation Microscopy Using Deconvolution of Complex Fields
abstract: We demonstrate a coherent super-oscillation (SO) microscopy imaging system based on the phase-shifting interferometry (PSI) technique, which is implemented without additional optics in the setup. With the Wiener filter deconvolution, we extended the limit of resolution with coherent illumination by a factor of 1.4 over the diffraction limit. © The Author(s)

articleTitle: Real-Time 12.5-Gbit/S Quantum Random Number Delivery Over Field-Installed Fiber VIA Coherent Light Transmission
abstract: We propose and demonstrate quantum random number generation based on vacuum fluctuation at a distance from the laser source. 12.5-Gbit/s unpredictable random numbers are distributed without optical transceivers over 4-km fiber installed in campus.

articleTitle: Three-Terminal Thyristor Random Access Memory Realized on a Monolithic Silicon CMOS Photonic Platform
abstract: We demonstrate Three-Terminal Thyristor Random Access Memory (3T TRAM) on a monolithic silicon-CMOS-photonic platform. The gate contact plays an important role in controlling dynamic memory characteristics and optimized design can lead to non-volatile characteristics.

articleTitle: Analog Information Processing on a Photonic Chip with Programmable Photonic Integrated Circuits
abstract: An architecture for efficient integrated photonic implementation of arbitrary discrete linear operators is discussed. This is built by interlacing waveguide arrays with programmable active layers.

articleTitle: Breaking the Beachfront Limitations with Silicon Photonics
abstract: We present a 2.5D integrated photonics platform for optical connectivity to the point-of- compute in high-power ASICs. Relying on electro-absorption modulators, the platform features exceptional temperature stability, low latency, and high bandwidth density.

articleTitle: Flexible Mode-Locking in a Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We present a new concept of integrated semiconductor laser providing broad, continuous and potentially fast tunable mode-locked frequency.

articleTitle: Hybrid Germanium-on-Zinc Selenide Waveguides for Longwave Infrared Integrated Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon-free germanium-on-zinc selenide (GOZ) platform for integrated longwave infrared photonics, achieving transparency from <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2\ \mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$14 \ \mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> and optical losses of just 1 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> (at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$7.8 \ \mu \mathrm{m})$</tex>.

articleTitle: Using Temporal Reflection for Probing the Trajectory of Raman Solitons Inside a Photonic Crystal Fiber
abstract: We discuss experiments employing temporal reflection inside a photonic crystal fiber to probe the trajectory of a decelerating short soliton undergoing Raman-induced red shift along the fiber's length.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Physical Layer Security in FSO Links by Longitudinally Tailoring the Noise Power to Overwhelm the Signal Power
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 120-Gbit/s 16-QAM free-space optical link with enhanced physical layer security by co-propagating a “noise” channel with longitudinally tailored transverse beam profile. 20-dB signal-to-interference ratio difference can be achieved at different longitudinal locations.

articleTitle: Graphene Field Effect Transistor on Silicon Nitride Devices for Near-Infrared Wavelength Tuning
abstract: In this work, we present the Graphene Field Effect Transistor (GFET) on Silicon Nitride waveguides for achieving the wavelength tuning in the Near-Infrared (NIR) range. The obtained Electrolyte-Graphene- Waveguide fabrication and characterization results are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Generation of High-Order Femtosecond Vortices Up to the 10th Order from a Powerful Mode-Locked Hermite-Gaussian Laser
abstract: We present a mode-locked Hermite-Gaussian Yb:KGW laser oscillator. The average powers and pulse durations of vortex pulses up to 10th via astigmatic mode conversion are several hundred milliwatts and less than 500 fs, respectively.

articleTitle: Continuous Wave Interband Cascade Lasers Near $\mathbf{13}\ \boldsymbol{\mu} \mathbf{m}$
abstract: We report continuous wave (cw) operation of interband cascade lasers (ICLs) with innovative active region operating near <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$13\ \mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>, the longest cw emission wavelength among ICLs, showing the further potential of ICLs.

articleTitle: 10-Gbit/s All-Optical Free Carrier Absorption Switching Induced by Two-Photon Absorption in Silicon Carbide Micro-Ring on Silicon Platform
abstract: 10-Gbit/s all-optical free carrier absorption switching based on the two-photon absorption is demonstrated by the silicon carbide micro-ring with a carrier lifetime of 20 ps for future synchronous OC-192 optical networking on the silicon platform. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Geometric Similarities and Topological Phases in Surface Magnon Polaritons
abstract: We investigate the properties of surface-magnon polaritons. Our theory predicts ways to strongly localize and enhance magnetic fields in the microwave range and to develop compact and lossless connectors interconnecting waveguides with different effective impedances. © The Author(s)

articleTitle: On the Correlation Between Femtosecond Laser-Induced Defects Taxonomy and Localized Accelerated Chemical Etching in Fused Silica
abstract: The non-ablative interaction of femtosecond laser pulses with fused silica leads to defects creation in the silica glass network. Here, we report on the correlation between defects and localized accelerated etching, that enables three-dimensional manufacturing process.

articleTitle: Warm Vapor Four-Wave Mixing for Generating Optical Quantum States
abstract: Warm atomic vapors make good, high-density, and highly nonlinear media for generating entangled quantum states. One- and two-mode squeezed states generated in this way are useful for quantum information processing and sensor applications.

articleTitle: High Temperature Measurements and Predictions Using Fiber Bragg Gratings and Neural Networks
abstract: Neural networks are utilized with FBGs in this paper to improve temperature prediction accuracy and speed. A minimum mean absolute error of 0.56°C is achieved in two rounds of 810°C furnace tests.

articleTitle: L-Band Tunable Mode-Locked Fiber Laser Achieving up to 19 kHz Wavelength Sweeping Rate
abstract: For the first time, we introduce a rapid wavelength-swept L-band tunable mode-locked fiber laser, boasting an exceptional wavelength sweeping rate of up to 19 kHz, enabled by external modulation of the pump current.

articleTitle: A Dual DFB Laser Based Temperature Sensor
abstract: In this manuscript, we present a temperature sensing method that utilizes a dual fiber laser system based on two adjacent pi-phase shift fiber Bragg gratings with a slight difference in wavelength.

articleTitle: Inverse Design of Dual-Band Metasurfaces for Vortex Fiber Lasers
abstract: We present a deep learning and genetic algorithm-driven inverse design strategy for dual-band metasurfaces, which can be applied to vortex fiber lasers around the wavelengths of 1030 nm and 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Enhanced Frequency Combs via Self-Crystallizing Cavity Solitons
abstract: A “self-crystallization” phenomenon of dark vectorial temporal cavity solitons can occur in Fabry-Perot resonators, with major applications in frequency comb generation. This phenomenon arises from the long-range interactions between symmetry-broken light fields with orthogonal polarizations. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Mechanical-Sharing Dual-Comb Fiber Laser for Terahertz Dual-Comb Spectroscopy
abstract: We developed a simple and compact terahertz spectroscopy system based on asynchronous optical sampling using a mechanical-sharing dual-comb fiber laser. The streamlined spectroscopy system successfully detected the absorption of airborne water molecules.

articleTitle: Monolithic High Contrast Grating Integrated with Metal as a Transparent Electrode for ICLED Devices
abstract: In this paper we present results of metalMHCG fabrication for GaSb-based ICLED by means of electron beam lithography, e-beam metal evaporation and plasma etching process. Configuration of metalMHCG was designed to maximize transmittance of TE polarized light in the mid-infrared wavelength region.© 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Experimental Observation of Space Time Surface Plasmon Polariton Wave Packet
abstract: Femtosecond space-time surface plasmon polariton wave packets, localized in all dimensions and exhibiting diffraction-free properties, have been excited on a Ag surface and their spatial fields are microscopically imaged with femtosecond time resolution.

articleTitle: Grating Coupled Attachment of Optical Fiber Arrays for in Situ Photonics Experimentation
abstract: We report a simple, vacuum-compatible fiber attach process for in situ study of grating-coupled photonic devices. The robustness of this technique is demonstrated on grating-coupled waveguides exposed to multiple X-ray irradiations for aerospace studies.

articleTitle: Large-Mode Area, Single-Mode, and Normal Dispersion Solid-Core Anti-Resonant Fiber Design For High Power Applications At 2 μm
abstract: In this study, we explore the applicability of negative curvature anti-resonant solid-core large mode area fibers to achieve single-mode, normal dispersion (-7.5 ps/nm/km) and minimal propagation losses at the 2 μ wavelength. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Design of a Zero-Coma Image Spectrometer with Ultra-High Resolution by Using a Multiple-Grating-Integrated Module
abstract: A zero-coma image spectrometer with ultra-high spectral resolution in the entire wavelength region was designed and demonstrated by using a multiple-grating-integrated module. Results show the unique merit of the spectrometer to be able for a wide range of spectral sensing and measurement applications

articleTitle: Polarization and Frequency-Bin Hyperentangled States on Chip
abstract: We present a programmable integrated source of polarization and frequency-bin hyperentangled states with a predicted purity of 99.96% and a generation rate of ~ 1 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> Hz.

articleTitle: Higher-Order Topological Corner and Edge Modes in Polaritonic 2D-SSH and Breathing Kagome Lattices
abstract: We demonstrate lasing from higher-order topological corner and edge modes in polaritonic two-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger and breathing Kagome lattices. Novel hybrid III/V-dielectric microcavities are implemented, ensuring precise inter-site couplings and thus topologically protected laser modes.

articleTitle: Diodes-Pumped Femtosecond Ti:Sapphire Lasers for Two-Photon Microscopy
abstract: We report compact and low-cost two femtosecond self-starting mode-locked Ti:sapphire lasers operating at different repetition rates of 76 MHz and 250 MHz, respectively, based on spectrally combined diodes-pumped sources.

articleTitle: Bright Heralded Single-Photon Source with Ideal Purity Based on Silicon Chip via Spontaneous Four Wave Mixing
abstract: We derive an explicit theoretical limit of purity for any heralded single-photon source, and subsequently demonstrate the ideal purity on an unprecedentedly bright source exceeding 1.5 MHz coincidence rate with the lowest <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$g_{h}^{(2)}(0)$</tex> value of 0.000945. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Power-Efficient Metasurface Thermal Emitter for Mid-IR Gas Sensing Application
abstract: We propose a narrow band, power-efficient, cost-effective and on-chip mid-infrared source <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\text{at}\approx 6.0 \ \mathrm{m})$</tex> for gas sensing applications. Combined an optimized microelectromechanical system heater with a metal-insulator-metal metasurface emitter, the source works successfully.

articleTitle: Quantum Cascade Lasers Powered by a Pulsed 6.78 MHz Wireless Power Transfer System
abstract: We demonstrate a high-frequency, pulsed, inductive, wireless power transfer system with a full-bridge diode receiver for quantum cascade lasers. It operates at 6.78MHz to create a pulsed 2μs 10V/1.2A output, for room-temperature pulsed laser operation.

articleTitle: Laser and Optical System for Sequential Resonant Excitation of High Energy Hydrogen Ion Beams
abstract: We report the design and operation of 140 mJ UV (355 nm) laser and optical system used in the sequential photoexcitation of hydrogen ion beams at 1.0 GeV energy recently demonstrated at the Spallation Neutron Source accelerator.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Second-Harmonic Generation in Bilayer Nonlinear Metamaterials
abstract: We study the dynamics of second-harmonic generation from a nonlinear plasmonic metamaterial composed of two layers with geometric phase difference, as a foundation for designing efficient and tunable multilayered nonlinear metamaterials.

articleTitle: A Recurrent Multiport Interferometer Architecture for Fault-Tolerant Programmable Photonics
abstract: We propose a novel multiport interferometer architecture that uses optical recursion to mitigate hardware errors and scales as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$O(N)$</tex>. We also show that it is possible to construct perfect transformations with imperfect beamsplitters meshes.

articleTitle: A 3D Image Sensor Based on Intentionally Shifted Focal Plane Switch Array with Detection Range Above 200 m
abstract: We proposed and demonstrated a novel three-dimensional (3D) scanning image sensor consisting of a lens and chip with a detection range of 204 m and 3D imaging of a building located 45 m away.

articleTitle: Optical Ranging - The Amorphous Silicon Intrinsic Photomixing Detector
abstract: The Intrinsic Photomixing Detector, a device enabling Time-of-Flight optical ranging up to ~70m and mean depth resolution of ~41.6mm, is presented. It may enhance pixel density and readout performance due to the utilized intrinsic mixing.

articleTitle: Photonics Integrated Circuits for Distributed Radar Systems in Space
abstract: A hybrid photonic integrated circuit enabling distributed multiband coherent MIMO radar systems for Earth observation from space is implemented. The characterization at device-level shows performances enabling the target application.

articleTitle: Active Optical Chiral Nanocavity Through MEMS-Integrated Twisted Bilayer Photonic Crystals
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a MEMS-integrated bilayer photonic crystals with tunable intrinsic chirality. By controlling the interlayer gap and twist angle between the two photonic crystal layers, the circular dichroism varies from 0 to 0.85.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Pulse Generation from a CW-Driven Degenerate Optical Parametric Oscillator
abstract: We describe a novel configuration of bulk <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\chi^{(2)}$</tex> OPO providing near-transform-limited sub-100 fs pulses with coherent broadband phase-locked spectrum when driven with a cw laser by deploying an intracavity electro-optic-modulator together with dispersion control.

articleTitle: Pulse Characterization by Spectral Correlation Function Measurement with a Quantum Pulse Gate
abstract: We measure the two-point spectral correlation function to completely charac-terize an ultrafast pulse with arbitrary level of coherence using a quantum pulse gate. Our method is readily applicable to single-photon pulses.

articleTitle: High Speed SOP Tracking Added by an Optical Domain Polarization Demultiplexing Prototype in Short Range Coherent Optical Communication System
abstract: We demonstrated a SOP tracking in a 10km coherent optical communication system, added by an optical-domain polarization demultiplexing prototype. The updating time interval of CMA taps is greatly lengthened about 25 times with 600krad/s SOP.

articleTitle: Quantum Pulse Position Modulation using Entangled States for Communication Security
abstract: Introducing Quantum Pulse Position Modulation (QPPM): an entanglement-based, secure pulse position modulation approach using two-mode entangled light and thermal noise for stealthy data transmission. Quantum bounds ensure secure symbol decoding, baffling eavesdroppers.

articleTitle: Free-Space Ultrahigh-Q Mode Resonances at Visible Wavelength with an Etch-Free Metasurface
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a free-space resonance quality (Q) factor of 2.09× 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> at 778 nm wavelength with an etch-free metasurface. The guided-mode-resonance nature is studied via energy-momentum spectroscopy, showing the full-visible-spectrum accessibility of our ultrahigh-Q resonances.

articleTitle: Noncritical, Narrowband, Intracavity Pumped CdSe OPO
abstract: We report on a noncritically phase-matched cascade CdSe optical parametric oscillator with an output energy of 0.54 mJ at 100 Hz, temperature tuning within 9274–9314 nm, and narrow spectrum achieved by a Volume Bragg Grating.

articleTitle: High-Performance Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Modulator with Low-k Underfill for over 110 GHz Electro-Optic Response
abstract: A thin-film lithium niobate modulator featuring low-k underfill is experimentally demonstrated. The 7-mm-long device exhibits a low half-wave voltage of 2 V and only 1.2 dB electro-optic roll-off up to 110 GHz.

articleTitle: Generation of Superfluorescence from Multiexcitons Confined in Semiconductor Quantum Dots
abstract: Superfluorescences from triexcitons and biexcitons confined in semiconductor quantum dots were observed by time-resolved photoluminescence measurements. Superfluorescence of the triexcitons shows a shorter pulse width and a broader spectral width than that of the biexcitons. © 2024 The Author(

articleTitle: Low-Loss 3D Fiber-to-Chip Couplers for Polymer Waveguides
abstract: We designed and demonstrated 3D polymer coupler structures to adiabatically couple light into polymer waveguides. We measured a coupling loss of 2.1 dB per coupler facet around 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Compressed Meta-Optical Encoder for Image Classification
abstract: For MNIST image classification, we compress a CNN to a single convolutional layer and linear electronic backend. We implement the convolution optically via engineering the PSF of meta-optics and demonstrate classification accuracy exceeding 93%. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Quasi-Continuous Air Waveguiding
abstract: Using high-repetition-rate structured multi-filamentation of femtosecond laser pulses, we generate a continuously operating air waveguide. We demonstrate undisrupted guiding of a CW probe beam with significantly improved performance.

articleTitle: Melanin Imaging with Pump-Probe Microscopy for Diagnosis of Metastatic Melanoma
abstract: Melanoma, the most aggressive skin cancer, is responsible for around 10,000 deaths annually. We are developing a diagnostic biomarker based on femtosecond pump-probe microscopy of melanin, a natural pigment found in most melanoma. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Biomimetic Transparent Nanoplasmonic Meshes for Bio-Interfaced Spatiotemporal Multimodal SERS Bioanalysis
abstract: This study introduces biomimetic transparent nanoplasmonic microporous mesh (BTNMM) devices fabricated via reverse nanoimprint lithography. These devices offer spatiotemporal multimodal SERS measurements for bio-interfaced applications, enabling targeted pH sensing and molecular profiling of microbial biofilms.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Integration of Spin-photon Interfaces with a Scalable CMOS Platform
abstract: We introduce a quantum system-on-chip (QSoC) architecture based on (I) a co-designed diamond quantum memory array, (II) a custom CMOS backplane, and (III) a protocol for fully connected cluster state generation. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Upconversion Enhancement Using Dielectric Metasurfaces
abstract: We integrate infrared-to-visible upconverting nanoparticles with an asymmetric dielectric metasurface to enhance their upconversion efficiency. An upconversion enhancement of up to ~100 times is achieved. We also demonstrate infrared-to-visible upconversion imaging using fabricated devices.

articleTitle: Hyperbolic Polariton Lenses For Sub-Diffractive Imaging
abstract: We introduce the design of lenses for hyperbolic surface phonon polaritons operated in the mid-infrared range. Based on Minkowski space considerations, these lenses offer unbounded numerical aperture and can largely overcome the diffraction limit on resolution imaging.

articleTitle: Development of CO2 Laser Pumped Terahertz Sources
abstract: Thorough investigation using advanced simulations showed that high energy single-cycle terahertz pulses can be generated with currently available CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser technology. Computations predict efficiencies up to 4% and electric fields above 3 MV/cm.

articleTitle: Clock Synchronization with Weak Coherent Pulses
abstract: We propose a simulated protocol for performing clock synchronization between two spatially separated parties utilizing weak coherent pulses (WCPs) and balanced Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interferometers instead of spontaneous parametric down converted photons (SPDC).

articleTitle: High-Power Single-Frequency Multimode Fiber Amplifier with Good Beam Quality
abstract: We demonstrate a single-frequency multimode-fiber amplifier free of stimu-lated Brillouin scattering up to 474 W. The optical efficiency is 89 % and spectrallinewidth is 19.8 kHz. We focus the output beam using input wavefront shaping.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection of WSS in ROADM Enabled by Single Sideband Multi-Tone Signal
abstract: We report an anomaly detection scheme of the wavelength selective switch using a single sideband multi-tone signal and 28.5MHz photodiode. The maximum measurement error of 0.5GHz and maximum error deviation of 0.15GHz are achieved.

articleTitle: 50fs, VIS and NIR Tunable Femtosecond Pulses via Hollow Core Fibre Spectral Broadening of Sub-Ps Yb Lasers
abstract: Starting from a 330fs Yb laser, we generate 50fs femtosecond VIS pulses (340–580 nm) and in the NIR (1600–2500 nm) via frequency mixing of spectral side lobes out of a hollow core fibre continuum.

articleTitle: Wavelength-Division-Multiplexed Transmission and Dispersion Compensation Enabled by Soliton Microcombs and Cascaded Microrings
abstract: We demonstrate wavelength-division-multiplexed data transmission and dispersion compensation of 25 Gb/s <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\times 9$</tex> on-off-keying signals over a 20-km singlemode fiber using an integrated single-soliton microcomb and a cascaded microring resonator-based reconfigurable dispersion compensator.

articleTitle: Enhanced Stimulated Brillouin Scattering in Tellurite Covered Silicon Nitride Waveguides via Geometric and Cladding Engineering
abstract: We measure Brillouin-scattering in geometrically and cladding engineered tellurite covered silicon nitride waveguide in which we report gain values of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$80.9 \mathrm{m}^{-1} \mathrm{W}^{-1}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$76.3 \mathrm{m}^{-1} \mathrm{W}^{-1}$</tex>, a 150 times improvement over previous silicon nitride based waveguides.

articleTitle: Field-Proven Laser Systems for Quantum Technologies
abstract: Exail has developed vertically integrated turnkey fibered laser system for quantum technologies. They have been extensively used in research laboratories, in field conditions in quantum gravimeters and are in the process of being space qualified.

articleTitle: Ultra-Compact Inverse-Designed Photonic Hadamard Transform
abstract: Ultra-compact photonic components enable massive scalability of optical networks on chip. We design, fabricate, and measure an ultra-compact (4 μm x 4 μm footprint) inverse designed phase-sensitive Hadamard transform.

articleTitle: Enhanced Sensitivity of Refractive-Index-Sensing Optical Comb by Frequency Multiplication Based on THz Comb
abstract: Refractive-index-sensing optical comb is capable of RF-reading high-precision refractive index (RI) measurements. To amplify the RI-dependent frequency shift, we report a method for frequency multiplication of the RF sensor signal based on THz comb. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Quantum Interferometry with X-Rays
abstract: We demonstrate the pioneering use of a quantum interferometer with x -rays, highlighting its effectiveness in precisely measuring the phase accumulated in opaque media. Our work uncovers novel opportunities for measuring sub-Angstrom optical-path differences.

articleTitle: Wafer-Scale Fabrication of InGaP-on-Insulator for Nonlinear Quantum Photonics Applications
abstract: We present 100-mm wafer fabrication of InGaP-on-insulator-a promising integrated quantum photonic platform with strong <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\chi^{(2)}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\chi^{(3)}$</tex>. We achieve 3.25 dB/cm waveguide loss and microresonators with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Q > 160,000$</tex> for entangled-pair generation.

articleTitle: Development of a Rydberg Atom-Based Charged Particle Beam Tracker
abstract: We present the development of a Rydberg-atom based optical sensor for detecting an electron beam with the goal of determining its position and width via a non-invasive electric field measurement. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: A Simple Optomechanical Platform with Ultra-Wide Phonon-Frequency Tunability
abstract: Phonon-frequency-tunable optomechanical interactions are demonstrated in shaped bulk acoustic resonators. Non-collinear all-optical coupling enables access to phonons with novel mode-selection rules, high quality factors (>10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup>), and frequency tunability over 10 GHz.

articleTitle: Prototyped and Upgraded Programmable on-chip Photonic Joint Transform Correlator-Based CNN
abstract: We manufacture and optimize a prototyped programmable on-chip photonic joint transform correlator-based convolution neural network. We also illustrate the upgraded potential of the system.

articleTitle: Long-Range Spin Transport in Indirect Excitons in MoSe2/WSe2 Heterostructure
abstract: We observed spin transport with decay distances exceeding 100 microns and diverging in indirect excitons (IXs) in MoSe2/WSe2 heterostructure. With increasing IX density, we observed spin localization, then long-range spin transport, then spin localization.

articleTitle: Unified Theory of Raman Scattering in Gas-Filled Hollow-Core Fiber Across Temporal Regimes
abstract: We present a theory of Raman scattering in gas-filled hollow-core fiber, connecting different temporal regimes. The theory provides new insights into Raman gain and Raman-induced index changes, and strategies on frequency conversion.

articleTitle: Efficient Single-Photon Upconversion Detection From SWIR to SPAD Using PPLN Waveguides
abstract: We present efficient single-photon upconversion detection from SWIR using a precision-machining waveguide fabrication process that offers high power handling and good mode coupling. We demonstrate an internal photon upconversion efficiency of 69%.

articleTitle: Towards All-Optical Cavity-Based Memory for Non-Gaussian Quantum State Engineering
abstract: We present our experimental results on all-optical memory to store and manipulate quantum states, and propose resource-efficient time-domain-multiplexed state engineering using the memory. This paves a path to scalable quantum information processors.

articleTitle: Characterization of Chirped Bragg Grating for Ultrafast Excitation of Rydberg Atoms
abstract: We precisely determine the chirp rate of a chirped Bragg grating, a highly dispersive optics with promising applications for spectral shaping of picosecond pulsed laser used for ultrafast Rydberg excitation.

articleTitle: Lensfree Nanoscopic Imaging and Sensing
abstract: Lensfree holographic microscopy provides an ultra-large field of view with submicron resolution using compact and cost-effective components. We discuss recent applications to time-gated fluorescence, air quality monitoring, and protein biosensing, including COVID-19 sensors.

articleTitle: Third-Order Harmonic Generation in Bulk Al2O3, Fe2O3, and Bi2Se3 Crystals
abstract: We present the analysis of the third-order harmonic generation in bulk crystals driven by a near-IR laser in the reflection geometry. We compare the energies of the third-order harmonic generated by these crystals.

articleTitle: 1.1-GHz SESAM-Modelocked Femtosecond Yb:YLF Laser
abstract: We report the first GHz Yb:YLF laser generating 210 fs long pulses at 40 mW average power output from a low-cost, self-starting, single-mode diode pumped cavity with integrated relative intensity noise <0.45%.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared Photonic Integration and Nonlinear Optics on InP
abstract: Due to its transparency and intersubband devices compatibility, InP platform is well-suited for mid-infrared photonic integration. We characterize mid-infrared losses and nonlinearities, demonstrate supercontinuum generation, and present functional components and device integration on this platform.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Ring-Cavity Yb:YAG Thin-Disk Oscillator with an Intra-Cavity Peak Power of 125 MW
abstract: We report a multi-pass ring-cavity Kerr-lens mode-locked Yb:YAG thin-disk oscillator. The output pulses had an average power of 71.5W and a pulse duration of 175 fs. The intra-cavity peak power was calculated as 125 MW.

articleTitle: Two-Photon Polymerization Assisted Fabrication of Polymeric Zone Plates
abstract: We demonstrate the implementation of two-photon lithography to fabricate zone plates in a polymer matrix. This technique facilitates creation of geometries with tailored responses by controlling the dimension and refractive index of the polymerized features. © The Author(s)

articleTitle: Observation of Boyer-Wolf Gaussian Modes
abstract: We experimentally observe a new family of fundamental laser modes of stable resonators: the Boyer-Wolf Gaussian modes. The lasing Boyer-Wolf Gaussian modes exhibit an inherent parabolic structure and show remarkable agreement with our theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Large Magneto-Optical Glass for Ultra-High Power Laser Isolators
abstract: A new magneto-optical glass with suppressed thermally induced depolarization was developed. The glass can be manufactured in large sizes, paving the way for the development of large-diameter isolators suitable for ultra-high power lasers.

articleTitle: All-Dielectric Metasurface with Over 500 nm of Tuning in the Midwave Infrared
abstract: An all-dielectric metasurface filter, based on an As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> metasurface paired with an As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> shifter, with over 500 nm of tuning in the midwave infrared is presented. Theoretical results are compared to experimental data.

articleTitle: Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) Multiplexing by Using the Attenuation Method
abstract: In this paper a novel approach to multiplexing quantum and classical channels into a single fiber is presented. A so-called attenuation method is used, that is mainly focused on suppressing the influence of Raman noise.

articleTitle: Broadband Mamyshev Oscillator at 1.7 µm
abstract: We demonstrate a single-pulse Mamyshev oscillator at 1. 7 µmusing Tm-doped fiber. The results of 5.4-MHz repetition rate and 95-nm optical spectrum bandwidth at 10 dB highlight its potential application for nonlinear microscopy.

articleTitle: Soliton Vortex Comb Generation in an AlGaAs Microresonator for Self-Torque Pulse Synthesis
abstract: We demonstrate bright soliton generation at room temperature within a grating-dressed AlGaAs-on-insulator microresonator and the simultaneous emission of phase-locked vortices, enabling the synthesis of self-torque pulses from the soliton vortex comb.

articleTitle: Compact Coherent Photonic Crystal Surface-Emitting Laser Arrays
abstract: We report a novel coherent beam combining design with passively coupled PCSEL array. Experimental results of our fabricated GaAs-based arrays show high beam quality, linewidth, and coherency.

articleTitle: Self-Suppressed Quantum Diffusion and Fundamental Noise Limit of Soliton Microcombs
abstract: We theoretically and numerically investigate the quantum diffusion of dissipa-tive Kerr solitons in multi-mode microresonators. Our results indicate that dispersive-wave radiation changes effective viscosity, reducing the diffusion rate by up to 20 dB.

articleTitle: A Ceramic Radiative Cooler with Near-Ideal Solar Reflectance and Intrinsic Selective Emittance
abstract: A ceramic bi-layer, owing to its porosity, long wavelength infrared (LWIR) Christiansen effect, and Reststrahlen band behavior, exhibits a near-ideal solar reflectance (R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">solar</inf> > 0.99) and a high selective LWIR emittance <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\varepsilon_{LWIR})$</tex> without the use of any metal backings. © The Author(s)

articleTitle: Brained-Inspired Optical Computing Unit Based on Transient Nonlinear Dynamics of Single-Mode Fibers
abstract: We developed and studied a hardware-based neuromorphic wave computer using optical nonlinearities. Here, we showcase the low-power consumption, robustness, and scalable complexity of soliton-based spectral broadening as a novel neuromorphic approach.

articleTitle: Imaging of Localized W-Hispering-Gallery-Modes in a Cylindrical Fiber
abstract: Modes of a dielectric cylindrical waveguide are characterized by three numbers: azimuthal number m, radial number, s, and a continuous propagation constant β.1 The azimuthal number determines the field dependence of the azimuthal angle φ of the cylindrical coordinate system with the polar axis along the axis of the cylinder in the form of exp(imφ). The radial number characterizes the behavior of the field in the radial direction and in an ideal cylinder is given by a cylindrical Bessel function Jm (Km,sr). Discrete values of the parameter ks characterizing the radial dependence of the field is determined by Maxwell boundary conditions. The propagation constant β describes the propagation of the mode along the axis of the fiber (Z-axis of the cylindrical coordinate system).

articleTitle: Free-Phase-Matching and Tunable-Gain Phase-Sensitive Amplification Based on Thin-Film Lithium Niobate
abstract: Based on substrate-removed thin-film lithium niobate, we demonstrate a tunable phase-sensitive amplification, which can achieve an extinction ratio of 30.6 dB and a maximum gain of 23 dB in wavelength ranges of 1530–1550 nm.

articleTitle: Guided Organic Exciton-Polaritons on Patterned Distributed Bragg Reflectors at Room Temperature
abstract: We demonstrate guided long-range excitation energy transport mediated by exciton-polaritons on different patterned distributed Bragg reflectors at room temperature, which results from strong coupling between organic excitons and low-loss Bloch surface wave (BSW) modes.

articleTitle: Fine-Periodic Nanostructure Formation on Solids with Few-Cycle Femtosecond Laser Pulses
abstract: We have demonstrated that intense 7-fs, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sim$</tex> 810-nm laser pulses can produce much finer periodic nanostructures on a diamond-like carbon (DLC) film, stainless steel, and gallium arsenide (GaAs) through ablation in air than those formed with intense 100-fs, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sim$</tex> ∼800-nm pulses. The periodicity can be explained as arising from short-range propagating surface plasmon polaritons excited at the interface between the substrate and a thin layer of high-density electrons.

articleTitle: Metal Etch Mask Morphology for Silica Optical Windows Verified by Transmission Spectra
abstract: This study focuses on the formation of gold islands on silica substrates via dewetting, for use as etching masks for anti-reflective structured surface fabrication, and corresponding analysis of optical transmission spectra of the gold masks.

articleTitle: Optically Active InGaAs Axial Nanowire Heterostructures for Quantum Integrated Photonic Circuits
abstract: We propose a monolithically integrated, vertical-cavity nanowire (NW) quantum light source coupled to a silicon (Si) quantum photonic integrated circuit (QPIC). Starting from modelling of the coupling efficiencies of an embedded quantum emitter and its dependencies on key geometrical parameters of NW/Si-waveguide dimensions, we further show experimental progress towards such a deterministic quantum light source using InGaAs emitters in a GaAs(Sb) NW cavity. Key understanding of the growth and optical properties of the InGaAs emitter is provided from systematic structure-property relationship studies.

articleTitle: Broadband Infrared Imaging via Silicon Metasurfaces
abstract: We demonstrate an innovative platform with nonlinear metasurfaces to convert images from broadband mid-infrared (2200–4000 nm) to visible via four-wave mixing. We minimise high-power signal requirements by tailoring the resonant metasurface at the pump wavelength. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Direct Observation of the Mechanism Behind Spectral Diffusion in Semiconductor Quantum Dots
abstract: Using high-resolution spectroscopy at cryogenic temperatures for single quantum dots under an external electric bias, we quantitatively show that the quantum-confined Stark effect is the cause of spectral diffusion. As a consequence, spectral fluctuations may be minimized by applying an adequate counter bias.

articleTitle: Hyperentangled Photon Pairs Emitted from an Integrated Source Delivering More than 1 Gpair/s
abstract: We demonstrate a high-rate source of hyperentangled photons based on a silicon racetrack resonator. Hyperentanglement is verified by violating Bell's inequality in both time and frequency domains, and obtaining a high-purity state using frequency-bin encoding.

articleTitle: Coherence Awareness in Diffractive Neural Networks
abstract: We demonstrate the significant influence of the illumination coherence on diffractive networks, and propose a framework for network optimization with any prescribed degree of spatial and temporal coherence. We analyze performance for varied coherence properties.

articleTitle: Solid-State Self-Steepening Enhanced Flat White Light
abstract: We generated intense near-two-octave spanning supercontinuum by self-steepening enhanced cascade process in solids. The output spectrum covered from 510 nm to 1450 nm with an ultra-flat-plateau, which supporting 0.8-cycle 2.7-fs TL pulse.

articleTitle: Integrated Microelectromechanical-System Optical Probes for Diagnosing Phase Errors of Programmable Photonic Integrated Circuits
abstract: We present using microelectromechanical-system optical probes in combination with an image analysis method to dynamically monitor the waveguide power of Mach-Zehnder interferometers for phase error diagnosis in programmable photonic integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Higher-Dimensional HOM Effect and Quantum State Routing with Directionally-Unbiased Linear-Optical Devices
abstract: A four-port beam-splitter only maps between two input and output modes. We introduce a more general four-port scatterer that supports a broader class of state transformations, enabling a higher-dimensional HOM effect and quantum state routing. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Targeted Enhancement of Nonlinear Response in Layered Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
abstract: We experimentally reveal and enhance weak second harmonic (SH) generation probed by a femtosecond pulse in monolayer WS2 polycrystals using a feedback based Wavefront Shaping (WFS) technique. © 2024 The Author(s)
