abstract: The dispersion-related optical-clock resampling of a swept-source optical coherence tomography in a silicon platform is demonstrated on the main interferometer through Hilbert-transform for the axial resolution of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$21.78 \mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>, which is limited by grating couplers. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Dual-Pumped Supercontinuum Generation in Molecular-Gas Filled Hollow-Core Fibers
abstract: We report the efficient generation of broadband and ultra-flat supercontinuum using deuterium-filled anti-resonant hollow-core fibers dual-pumped with pulses centered at 515 nm and 1030 nm wavelength.

articleTitle: High-Coherence Hybrid-Integrated 780 nm Source by Self-Injection-Locked Second-Harmonic Generation in a High-Q Silicon-Nitride Resonator
abstract: A hybrid-integrated visible laser source is demonstrated using the photogalvanic effect. Self-injection locking of a 1560 nm semiconductor laser to a high-Q <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{S}\mathrm{i}_{3}\mathrm{N}_{4}$</tex> resonator generates high-coherence 780 nm emission (4 Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/Hz frequency noise floor).

articleTitle: Dual-Comb Spectroscopy with 200,000 Resolved Comb Teeth Across Mid-IR to THz at Video (69 Hz) Rate
abstract: Using electro-optically sampled dual-comb spectroscopy we performed high-resolution spectroscopic measurements across an unprecedented 1.5-45 THz (6.6-200μm) spectral range with simultaneous acquisition of octave-wide spectra (200,000 comb lines) at 69-Hz rate.

articleTitle: Experimental Observation of Resonant Chiral Modes in Free-Space Cavities
abstract: We report on experimental observation of pure chiral resonant modes in a spin-preserving Fabry-Pérot cavity enabled by geometric-phase reflective metasurfaces. The cavity, stabilizing one spin of light, also preserves the helicity during round propagation of light.

articleTitle: Mid-Infrared Optical Coherence Tomography with an OP-GaP Optical Parametric Oscillator
abstract: We demonstrate mid-infrared time-domain OCT with an OP-GaP optical parametric oscillator. Broadband spectra tunable from 5–11 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> provide reduced scattering for OCT applications. Volumetric imaging inside a plastic bank card is demonstrated at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$5.1\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Fast and Accurate Interrogation of Vernier Effect-Based Optical Fiber Sensors Enabled by Machine Learning
abstract: The possibility of employing a light source with a small wavelength bandwidth (35 nm) and a coarsely resolved spectrometer (~ 166 pm) for the interrogation of a Vernier effect-based high-sensitivity optical fiber sensor is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Programmable High-Dimensional Mode-Sorting of Time-Frequency States of Single Photons
abstract: We demonstrate a high-dimensional mode-sorter for single photons based on a multi-output quantum pulse gate, which can programmatically switch encoding between temporal modes, frequency bins and time bins, reaching a fidelity of 0.967 ± 0.031 at the single-photon level. © The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultrafast Nanoscopy of Single-Grain Morphology and Charge Carrier Dynamics in Metal Halide Perovskites
abstract: Deep-subcycle shifts of terahertz near-field waveforms reveal the interplay of ultrafast carrier dynamics and nano-morphology in metal halide perovskites. A surprising robustness of out-of-plane diffusion against structural and chemical variations is found on the nanoscale.

articleTitle: 4K Real-Time Video Transmission in Invisible Infrared-band Underwater-Airborne Bidirectional Optical Wireless System Using a Single Silver Mirror as an Aerial Repeater
abstract: We demonstrated real-time 4K video transmission over an underwater-to-air optical wireless channel in a bidirectional class 1 eye-safe communication system with an aerial relay mirror and frequency-domain adaptive modulation in the complete non-visible light band. (Tel: +81 87.864.2231, e-mail: kodama.takahiro@kagawa-u.ac.jp).

articleTitle: Analysis of Acoustic Sensing via Optical Fiber Cables
abstract: We report a measurement of optical fiber cables sensitivity to acoustic waves. An anechoic room was utilized for the measurement. Several objective parameters were evaluated w.r.t. various types of optical fiber cables.

articleTitle: Continuous Variables Cluster States in Photonic Time-Crystals
abstract: We show that Photonic Time-Crystals (PTCs) produce two-mode squeezing for pairs of photonic modes. We propose an algorithm for generating a cluster state in PTC for a measurement-based quantum computing in a simple three-step process.

articleTitle: Optical Pumping of Electronic Quantum Hall States with Vortex Light
abstract: We present a novel mechanism for the transfer of orbital angular momentum from optical vortex beams to electronic quantum Hall states. Specifically, we identify a robust contribution to the radial photocurrent in an annular graphene sample within the quantum Hall regime that depends on the vorticity of light. Our findings offer fundamental insights into the optical probing and manipulation of quantum coherence, with wide-ranging implications for advancing quantum coherent optoelectronics.

articleTitle: Phase Stabilization with Single Photon Detection for Quantum Networks
abstract: We demonstrate phase stabilization of a 3.2 km quantum network link with faint light. Our stabilization signal can empower phase-reliant quantum communication protocols and supports coexistent multiplexing of classical/quantum channels in a scaleable quantum network.

articleTitle: Spatial Quantum Beating in a Cavity-Filtered Biphoton Frequency Comb
abstract: We examine frequency entanglement via spatial quantum beating in a biphoton frequency comb, for both doubly and singly-filtered cases. The observed HOM revival is the incoherent superposition of SQB from different frequency pairs.

articleTitle: Dual-Comb Spectroscopy in the Deep Ultraviolet
abstract: Time-resolved dual-comb spectroscopy was performed at the shortest wave-lengths to date in the deep ultraviolet. Measurements on laser-produced plasmas provide both atomic and ion number densities while spectral analysis yields temperature and elec-tron density evolution.

articleTitle: Inhomogeneous Broadening in Time Domain Solvers: Gauss-Lorentz, Gauss-Drude, and Gauss-Debye Models
abstract: We develop a systematic approach to introduce inhomogeneous broadening in the Lorentz/Drude/Debye models. Implementation in the time/frequency domains uses minimax semi-analytical approximation. Applications include simulations of the systems with plasma and multilevel carrier kinetics.

articleTitle: 10% Component Efficiency of Fully Integrated and Oxide Embedded Photonic Crystal Cavity
abstract: We demonstrated low insertion loss fully integrated photonic crystal cavity with on-chip metalens coupling, with experimentally measured total quality factor of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>• © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Vicinity of Exceptional Point-Induced Mode-Locking in Coupled Microresonators
abstract: A coupled-cavity system with gain and loss enables mode-locking without natural saturable absorbers. Our theoretical and numerical findings demonstrate significant modulation in system <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Q$</tex> near the exceptional point (EP), even with minor refractive index changes and minimal Kerr effect involvement.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Time-Amplitude Analog MAC Circuit with Silicon Nitride Electro-Photonics
abstract: We report a silicon nitride microring resonator (MRR) based electro-photonic circuit that utilizes pulse width-amplitude modulated signals to perform a temporal dot-product operation between two large vectors (up to 10,000 elements each) with > 8-bit accuracy and precision. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Non-Geodesic Propagation in Integrated Curved Nanophotonic Structures
abstract: We present an experimental observation of electromagnetic wavepackets propagating on non-geodesic trajectories in curved space by shaping them via integrated nanophotonic grating and confining them to a nanophotonic structure emulating two-dimensional curved space.

articleTitle: Active Beam Shaping in a 1.5 μm Pulsed Single-Frequency Multimode Fibre Amplifier
abstract: We demonstrate single-frequency 1550 nm pulsed amplification using Er/Yb co-doped multimode fiber, achieving 1.5 kW peak power and 11 dB gain at 10kHz. Adjusting the seed wavefront, we obtained good output beams while maintaining gain and linewidth.

articleTitle: Polarization-Entangled Photon-Pair Sources Based on 3R-MoS2
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time generation of polarization-entangled photon-pairs in a transition metal dichalcogenide. Using 3R-phase molybdenum disulfide, we experimentally show tunable, high-fidelity generation of different polarization Bell states.

articleTitle: Multi-Month Observations of Spatial and Temporal Variation of CH4 and CO2 Over km-Scale Paths in New York City Using Open-Path Dual-Comb Spectroscopy
abstract: We deploy an open-path dual-comb spectrometer to measure CO2 and CH4 across multiple paths at an urban site in New York City. The system operated remotely for more than 3 months.

articleTitle: Perfect Two-Photon State Transfer In a Trimer Of Three-Level Systems Using Laser Pulses
abstract: We investigate two-photon transfer in a trimer of coupled three-level systems excited by laser pulses. We show that perfect state transfer and maximal entanglement are possible for certain detunings on the central site. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Low Back-Reflection 2x2 MMI Developed for Silicon-Nitride Platform
abstract: In this paper, a novel design of a low-reflection Silicon Nitride (SiN) 2x2 MMI on the IMEC's iSiPP200 platform is proposed. The simulation results predict that reflections are −71 dB and −70 dB for in-phase and out-of-phase inputs, respectively.

articleTitle: Continuous Strain Profiling with Low-Coherence Brillouin Optical Correlation-Domain Reflectometry
abstract: We experimentally measure a continuous strain distribution using low-coherence Brillouin optical correlation-domain reflectometry, which suppresses the noise caused by the sidelobes of a beat spectrum of conventional sinusoidal modulation.

articleTitle: Voltage-Modulated Nanoplasmonic Metal Luminescence in Electrochemical Surface-Enhanced Raman Spectroscopy
abstract: This study explores dynamic voltage-modulated nanoplasmonic metal luminescence at the electrode-electrolyte interface using nanolaminate nano-optoelectrode arrays. We demonstrate a negative voltage modulation slope in nanoplasmonic metal luminescence during electrochemical surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy measurements.

articleTitle: Programmable Quantum Emitter Formation in Silicon
abstract: Here, we demonstrate local writing and erasing of selected light-emitting defects using fs laser pulses in combination with hydrogen-based defect activation and passivation which also lead to rediscovering a potential Spin-photon qubit.

articleTitle: Injection-Seeded 60-GHz Bandwidth Tunable High-Frequency Backward Terahertz-Wave Parametric Oscillator
abstract: We report an injection-seeded high-frequency (~0.87 THz) backward terahertz-wave parametric oscillator with a slant-stripe-type periodically-poled lithium niobate. Substantial reduction in oscillation threshold and enhanced pump energy conversion efficiency were observed against the unseeded case.

articleTitle: Energy Transfer between Alq3 Molecules and Si Revealed by Pump-Probe Spectroscopy
abstract: We employ ultrafast optical pump-probe spectroscopy to reveal the energy transfer (ET) mechanism between organic Alq<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> molecules and Si. Inserting ultrathin SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> layers between Alq<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and Si exposes SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-thickness-dependent relaxation dynamics of photoexcited carriers and discloses ET from Alq<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> to Si, comparable with a dipole-dipole interaction model.

articleTitle: Highly Efficient Photonic Multiplexing Chip Using Low-Loss Silicon Nitride Recirculating Loops
abstract: A highly efficient photonic multiplexing chip employing recirculating loops is proposed. The chip achieves a threefold reduction in both energy and time consumption in Hamiltonian evo-lution and RNN training.

articleTitle: Filtered High-Chirp Directly-Modulated Membrane Lasers for Ultra-Energy-Efficient High-Sensitivity Communications
abstract: High-fidelity waveforms are generated with record 5.2 fJ/bit modulation energy using high-chirp directly-modulated membrane lasers on silicon at an emerging space-lasercom data rate of 2.88 Gbps, utilizing passive high-contrast optical filtering.

articleTitle: Non-Hermitian Swallowtail Degeneracy in the Two-Mode Squeezing of Light
abstract: We show that swallowtail catastrophe consisting of various-order non-Hermitian degeneracies naturally exists in the dynamics of two-mode quadrature squeezing systems with asymmetric losses that break pseudo-Hermiciticy and propose a practical ex-perimental setup.

articleTitle: Optimal Continuous Dynamical Decoupling in N-type Atomic Ensemble Quantum Memories
abstract: We simulate N-type quantum memory in atomic ensembles with a high-lying sensor state in the regime of continuous dynamical decoupling. We find order-of-magnitude memory lifetime enhancements for realistic experimental parameters.

articleTitle: Laser Driven White Light Generation with Specially Shaped Phosphor
abstract: In this work, two types of phosphors, a flat surface and a curved surface, are simulated with LightTools software to show that the introduction of curvature on the material can help with heat accumulation and light generation in laser driven phosphor conversion applications. © The Author(s)

articleTitle: 60 GHz Adiabatic Microring Modulator with Ultra-Wide 80nm Operation Wavelength Range
abstract: A novel adiabatic silicon microring modulator with >20dB extinction across 80nm wavelength range is demonstrated for the first time. The modulator has over 60GHz modulation bandwidth and supports up to 250Gb/s (125Gbaud) PAM-4.

articleTitle: Generation of Harmonic Mode-Locking in an All-PM Tm-Doped Fiber Laser Via Linear-Cavity Interferometric NPE
abstract: We demonstrate an all-polarization-maintaining Tm-doped fiber laser mode-locked by linear-cavity interferometric NPE, achieving robust 3rd-order harmonic mode-locking at 1934 nm with a pulse duration of ∼720 fs and a repetition rate of 36 MHz.

articleTitle: Optical Power-Handling Capabilities of Active Phase-Change Metasurfaces
abstract: Phase-change materials can deliver active metasurfaces, but it is not well-studied how these devices perform in high-power applications. We develop a model for optical performance changes induced by high-power lasers, applying it to two metasurface designs.

articleTitle: A Crown Ether Decorated Silicon Photonic Platform to Safeguard Against Lead Poisoning in Society
abstract: Lead poisoning is an ongoing public health crisis. We present the foremost development of a lead-selective crown ether/silicon photonic platform. We envisage the potential application of this technology to safeguard against pervasive societal lead poisoning.

articleTitle: Resonance Nesting and Degeneracy of Bilayer Spherical Dielectric Cavities Within Zero-Index Materials
abstract: We investigate the mode characteristic of bilayer spherical dielectric cavities embedded in ZIMs and find the resonance and mode degeneracy effect. Superior to monolayer cavities, the electric field distribution and mode degeneracy of bilayer cavities can be manipulated by changing the geometrical sizes.

articleTitle: Unitary Control of Absorption and Emission
abstract: Unitary control changes absorption and emission by transforming external modes. We answer two basic questions: What absorptivity, emissivity, and their difference are attainable via unitary control? How to obtain given absorptivity, emissivity, and their difference? © The Author(s)

articleTitle: Coherent Excitation of Chiral Phonons Using THz Light
abstract: A circular polarized THz pulse is used to excite coherent chiral phonon motion in non-magnetic LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta$</tex>-BaB<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, which in turn induces a transient magnetic moment that we probe via the ultrafast Faraday effect. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Inverse Design of Digital Mode (De)multiplexer with Large Fabrication Tolerance Using the Modified Adjoint Method
abstract: A three-channel mode (de)multiplexer with fabrication tolerance using the Modified adjoint method is proposed and experimentally demonstrated, providing insertion losses < 2 dB, crosstalks of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$< 17\text{dB}$</tex> and large fabrication tolerance of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm 10$</tex> nm.

articleTitle: Unidirectional Dispersive Grating Emitters for Silicon Photonic Beam Steerers
abstract: We demonstrate unidirectional grating emitters in which the phase-matching condition is satisfied only for the upward diffraction. The fabricated device shows unidirectionality of 83% and strong angular dispersion of 0.81°/nm, enabling efficient beam steering. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Non-Hermitian Non-Blocking Switching on a Silicon Integrated Photonic Chip
abstract: Applying parity-time (PT) symmetry, we demonstrate a large-scale non-blocking optical switch array on a III- V/Si integrated photonic chip. Light is routed between the vertically coupled waveguides by gain/loss control of the III-V layer.

articleTitle: Phase-Change-Material Integrated, Phase-Error Corrected, Resolution-Enhanced Michelson Interferometer Fourier Transform Spectrometer
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a hybrid silicon waveguide integrated with phase change materials to enable active phase error correction for spectral decomposition in compact on-chip Fourier Transform spectrometer based on spatially heterodyned array of Michelson interferometers.

articleTitle: Complex Photonic Media and their Interfaces: Space-Time Speckle Correlations
abstract: We demonstrate the existence of novel space-time speckle correlations in multiply scattering media and use them to assess the evolution of randomness from the optical interface to far away into the bulk of scattering media.

articleTitle: A Novel Idea of Plasma-Based Pulse Compression for Compact Exawatt Lasers
abstract: A negatively chirped pulse can be compressed in a density gradient plasma. Compression of a 2.35 picosecond pulse into a 10.3 femtosecond pulse with peak intensity up to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> was demonstrated by particle-in-cell simulations.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Optics of Graphene and Other Post-2000 Materials Nathalie Vermeulen
abstract: Since 2000 various new nonlinear-optical materials have emerged, including 2D materials such as graphene. After highlighting graphene's nonlinear response at optical and THz frequencies, I will briefly discuss a new data table for post-2000 nonlinear-optical materials.

articleTitle: Self-Injection Locking to Mitigate the Impact of Chip-Scale Reflections in Hybrid-Integrated Quantum-Well Lasers
abstract: We investigate the dynamics of quantum-well DFB lasers when they are hybrid- integrated via a photonic wire bond to a silicon photonic integrated circuit (PIC). By controlling the phase and amplitude of self-injection, the PIC stabilizes the laser.

articleTitle: Mode-Hop-Free Tunable Chip-Scale Laser at 780 nm for Integrated Quantum Photonic and Atomic Applications
abstract: We report a > 100 GHz mode-hop-free tunable III-V-on-Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> laser operating from 770–785 nm with < 5 kHz intrinsic linewidth. We demonstrate pumping of a high-Q Si3N4 microresonator entangled-photon pair source and locking to the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb D2 line. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Superharmonic Injection Locking in Bragg-Reflection Waveguide Lasers
abstract: The intra-cavity second order nonlinearity of a Bragg-reflection waveguide laser (BRW laser) was used to generate a second harmonic signal that serves as seed for injection locking the BRW laser. The exact phase-matching inside the BRW allows for the generation a second harmonic signal directly in the laser cavity. The subsequent injection locking results in a phase-coherent signal at the second-harmonic frequency of the master laser with a power 23.19dB higher than the second-harmonic signal from the unbiased unlocked device.

articleTitle: Intervalley Charge-Carrier Dynamics in Type-II InAs/ AlAs1-x Sbx Multiple Quantum Wells
abstract: Photocarrier dynamics are measured in type-II MQW heterostructures for excitation that allows for relaxation through the L-valley. Both characteristic timescales of relaxation and the decay mechanisms are modified from those without intervalley scattering.

articleTitle: Distributed Strain Sensing by Frequency-Selective Fading in Phase-OTDR
abstract: We demonstrate a novel approach using frequency-selective fading in phase-OTDR systems to measure dynamic strain on a fiber optic cable. We present the measurements of 200 Hz, 0.03 µε strain at 2 kHz interrogation frequency. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Random Laser Emission at 1348 nm From Nd:YVO4 Crystal Powder
abstract: Nd:YVO4 powder random lasers have shown high efficiency in 1064 nm emission with 806 nm excitation. Here, by using 585 nm excitation, we show laser emission for 1348 nm for the first time.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Ultrafast Imaging for Defect Inspection in Silicon Carbide Wafers
abstract: We demonstrate wafer-scale detection of defects in silicon carbide epitaxial layers and substrates using nonlinear imaging. Defects that alter the band structure appear in the nonlinear images; some are distinguishable by their ultrafast decay time. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Charge Separation in Metal-Semiconductor Nanocatalytic Heterojunctions
abstract: The rate equation associated with recombination dynamics of photoexcited charge carriers in Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O and Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O/Pd nanocatalysts shows suppressed Auger scattering in Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O/Pd possibly due to the photoexcited electron transfer across the heterojunction.

articleTitle: Random Laser Carries Complex Patterns Through Multimode Fiber via Learning Inverse Transmission Matrix
abstract: We introduce random laser into a single-fiber image transmission system for the first time. High-quality transmission of complex grayscale patterns is achieved with inverse transmission matrix. It provides guidance for fiber imaging and flexible endoscopy.

articleTitle: Light Absorption Properties in the LH1-RC Photosynthetic Complex Using a Laser Pulse
abstract: We analytically derive the wavefunction for the LH1-RC photosynthetic com-plex excited by a laser pulse. We demonstrate that the light absorption process with a reso-nant pulse is marginally less efficient than the single photon case.

articleTitle: Characterization of Two-Dimensional Materials Using Ultrafast Spectroscopy and Imaging
abstract: We demonstrate a rapid non-contact determination of layer thickness for transition metal dichalcogenides using hyperspectral four-wave mixing imaging, applicable to in-situ growth characterization. We further characterize the material with decay time maps.

articleTitle: Active Mode Conversion Based on Cascaded Intra- and Inter-Modal Four-Wave Mixing Effects
abstract: We present an active mode conversion without parasitic wavelength conversion, by the use of cascaded intra- and inter-modal four-wave mixing (FWM) effects. The crosstalk between LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf> and LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> mode conversion is below −7.0 dB.

articleTitle: Exploiting Ferroionic 2D Materials for Enhanced Electro-Optic Functionality in Silicon Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate the strong electro-refractive response of CuCrP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> (CCPS)-integrated SiPh microring resonators in the near-infrared wavelength. Results show significant refractive index tuning of 2.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> RIU with low optical losses and high modulation efficiency, outperforming earlier TMDs-based phase shifters. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultra-High Efficiency Fully-Etched Grating Coupler for Transverse Magnetic Mode with Al Mirror
abstract: We have designed and fabricated aluminum mirror assisted fully-etched photonic crystal grating couplers for transverse magnetic light coupling on the 250 nm silicon-on-insulator platform, showing ultra-high coupling efficiency of −1.2 dB at different waveband couplers. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Femtosecond Pulse Characterization Using Nanophotonic Parametric Amplification
abstract: We introduce and experimentally demonstrate a FROG-based ultrashort pulse characterization technique using nanophotonic parametric amplification as a crucial tool for ultrafast nanophotonic circuits, and measure sub-50-femtosecond pulses.

articleTitle: Amplified Cooling of Light via Emergent Onsager Irreversible Thermodynamics
abstract: While conventional cooling schemes solely depend on temperature differences, here we demonstrate that in photonics configurations, amplified cooling can be achieved by judiciously manipulating Onsager coefficients through engineering the density of states of the structure.

articleTitle: A Silicon-Based Integrated Photonic-Assisted Emitter for High Date-Rate Microwave Wireless Communication
abstract: In this work, we propose and demonstrate a silicon-based integrated photonic-assisted emitter. It consists of an aperiodically distributed traveling wave photodetector (TWPD), a compact Yagi antenna and a bias circuitry network. The measured radiated power of this emitter is above -20 dBm from 31 GHz to 38 GHz. Furthermore, a wireless data transmission at 3/5/8 Gbps is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Low Noise Microwave Generation for Quantum Information Systems via Cryogenic Extended-InGaAs Photodiodes
abstract: We demonstrate low-noise photonic microwave generation derived from 1550 nm fs- pulses via cryogenic extendedingaAs photodiode. The phase noise is 18 dB below the shot-noise limited amplitude noise, and >20 dB below that of modulated-CW illumination.

articleTitle: Two-Photon Process in Free Electron Radiation
abstract: We propose and investigate analytically the new phenomenon of two-photon emission by free electrons. It's found two-photon emission can be greatly enhanced by increasing transverse field of light in a specific photonic structure.

articleTitle: Diode-Pumped Sub-100-fs SESAM Mode-Locked Tm, Ho: CLNGG Laser at 2090 nm
abstract: We present a diode-pumped SESAM mode-locked Tm, Ho: CLNGG laser operating at 2090 nm, representing the first demonstration of an affordable diode-pumped sub-100-fs mode-locked laser in the 2-µm wavelength range.

articleTitle: Optical Biosensing Using Whispering Gallery Mode Microspherical Shell Resonators
abstract: Novel biosensors employing whispering-gallery-mode microshell resonators are demonstrated. Thermo-optical biosensing detects urea, while refractive index-based biosensors show high sensitivity to gold coated nanoparticles, promising applications in biochemical sensing for medical, environmental, and food safety.

articleTitle: Photon-Pair Generation via Raman-Active N2 Defects in Silicon Nitride Waveguides
abstract: We show preliminary photon-pair generation data from Raman-active interstitial N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> defects in silicon nitride waveguides. Using calculated phase-mismatch of the propagating photons, we propose an experimental scheme for deterministic single-photon generation using non-degenerate pumping wavelengths.

articleTitle: Foveation for Enhancing Deep Tissue Imaging
abstract: The work proposed in this submission combines ideas from the operation of human visual systems and computational imaging to optimally allocate sampling resources and improve the sampling density of diffuse optical imaging methods.

articleTitle: Examining Thermal Waves at Liquid-Vapor Interface Far from Equilibrium with Dark Hollow Beams
abstract: Remotely measuring the liquid-vapor interfaces far from thermal equilibrium is a daunting task. We demonstrate that scattering of dark hollow beams enhances considerably the sensitivity to temperature changes and permits detecting subtle interface fluctuations.

articleTitle: Optical Trapping with Inversely Designed Plasmonic Nanotweezers with Multiple Resonances
abstract: We optically trap 20 nm polystyrene nanospheres with inversely designed plasmonic aperture nanotweezers. These have two resonances that produce strong near-field enhancement across a common nanogap, with the goal of simultaneously enhancing absorption and emission.

articleTitle: Broadband Light Beam Steering by Optical Phased Array Based on Phase-Controlled Optical Frequency Comb
abstract: The proposed method employs a broadband optical phased array with a phase-controlled optical frequency comb for scanning optical dots. Precise control of the frequency parameters of the comb eliminates the need for optical setup calibration.

articleTitle: High Speed Optical Wireless Receiver with Wide Coverage
abstract: An optical wireless receiver at 850 nm is realized, providing 8.6 Gbps maximum data rate and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$> 7$</tex> Gbps data rate across a 9.5 cm lateral coverage at 3 m range with a BER of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$< 2\times 10^{-3}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Stochastic Logic in Biased Coupled Photonic Probabilistic Bits
abstract: We propose an experimentally viable photonic approach to solve arbitrary probabilistic computing problems. Our proposition relies on a network of coupled optical parametric oscillators that are controlled with a bias field.

articleTitle: Selective Area Growth of Ga-and N-Polar InGaN/GaN Nanowires - A Comparative Study
abstract: InGaN quantum disks in GaN nanowires are grown on both Ga-and N-polar GaN templates. Comparative analysis indicates superior geometric control in N-polar GaN with higher vertical, reduced lateral growth rates, flat tops, and increased indium-incorporation compared to Ga-polar.

articleTitle: Study on the Effect Of Discrepancy Information in the High-Dimensional Domain on Resolution Improvement of the Ghost Imaging Camera
abstract: Imaging resolution limit of the ghost imaging camera is investigated via the statistical resolution framework. Both theoretical and simulation results confirm that the resolution improvement can be achieved by utilizing the discrepancy information in the high-dimensional domain.

articleTitle: Geiger-Mode Single Photon Detection at $2\ \mu \mathrm{m}$
abstract: We report the first <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2\ \mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> Geiger-mode single photon counting results using an AlInAsSb SACM avalanche photodiode. Avalanche probabilities greater than 90% were measured at 80 K, corresponding with single photon detection efficiencies of 12.6%. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Spatiotemporally Resolved Dual-Band Hyperchromatic Structural Color with a Mesoporous Metamaterial
abstract: We present an approach to achieve highly responsive structural color utilizing dual-band porous silicon rugate filter metamaterials combined with dichromatic laser illumination. Spatiotemporally resolved sensing experiments are reported.

articleTitle: Exciton-Polaritons Generated From Strong Coupling Between CdSe Nanoplatelets and a Fabry-Pérot Cavity
abstract: Exciton-polaritons generated from strong coupling between CdSe nanoplatelets with confined photons in a Fabry-Pérot cavity are studied via angle-resolved spectroscopy. Their room-temperature existence and interesting photophysics hold promise for manipulating chemical reactions.

articleTitle: Extended OCT Depth Range and Phase Stability Using Ultrasonically-Sculpted Optical Waveguides
abstract: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) can provide label-free cross-sectional imaging of tissue microstructure over 2–3 mm of depth with micron-scale resolution. While phase-based functional extensions including angiography and polarization-sensitive OCT greatly expand the utility of OCT, the fixed lenses typically used to focus light into a sample couples the lateral resolution with the depth of focus. Ultrasonically-sculpted virtual optical waveguides provides an alternative for the terminal focusing element in an OCT sample arm. Ultrasonic pressure applied to a medium modulates its refractive index and can be used to create a refractive index gradient similar to that in a GRIN lens. We have recently demonstrated that a cylindrical ultrasound transducer can be used in the sample arm of a spectral-domain OCT system. <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> We present demonstration that an ultrasound-based virtual lens can provide sufficient phase-stability for flow imaging, and that near-beam waist lateral resolution can be maintained over an extended depth range.

articleTitle: All-Optical Switching Based on Silicon Nanocavities Boosted by Two-Dimensional Semiconductors
abstract: We propose and demonstrate hybrid all-optical switching devices that combine silicon nanocavities and two-dimensional semiconductor materials, successfully overcoming the intrinsic switching speed limitation of silicon while maintaining low switching energy.

articleTitle: High Efficiency Fiber-Chip Edge Coupler for Near-Ultraviolet (NUV) Waveband
abstract: We design and experimentally demonstrate an efficient fiber-chip edge coupler for NUV using symmetric double-tip taper and MMI-based coupler. We measure the coupling loss down to 2.85 dB at 407 nm on an alumina-on-insulator platform. © The Author(s)

articleTitle: Integrated Preparation of Photonic Spin-Orbit Qudits
abstract: Preparing and manipulating N-dimensional flying qudits as well as subsequently establishing their entanglement are still challenging tasks. Here, using an integrated approach, we explore the synergy from two degrees of freedom of light, spatial mode and polarization, to generate, encode, and manipulate flying photon qudits in a four-dimensional Hilbert space with high quantum fidelity, intrinsically enabling enhanced noise resilience and higher quantum data rates.

articleTitle: Loss Prediction and 3D Trajectory Design of Photonic Wire Bonds Using Artificial Neural Networks (ANN)
abstract: We present an artificial-neural-network-(ANN-)driven concept for predicting transmission losses of 3D-printed freeform waveguides within a few milliseconds and with root-mean-square errors of less than 0.5 %. Our approach enables transmission-optimized trajectory design of photonic wire bonds during fabrication.

articleTitle: Single-Mode Amplification in a Multimode Fiber Regenerative Amplifier
abstract: We show that regenerative amplification enables a femtosecond fiber amplifier with an unprecedented combination of features: single-mode operation (M2 ≤ 1.3) despite multimode (100 μm) fiber, high-gain (> 55 dB), and high pulse energy (> 50 μJ).

articleTitle: Prediction of Laser Beam Spatial Profiles in a Multipass, High-Energy Laser Facility Using Deep Learning
abstract: Deep-learning models based on the U-Net architecture have been characterized for accuracy and speed to support real-time laser performance prediction in multipass, high-energy laser facilities, providing a prediction time of 1.3 ms.

articleTitle: First Principles Calculation of Impact Ionization in Solids
abstract: A theoretical calculation of impact ionization using quantum transport is presented here. An atomistic matrix Hamiltonian in real space, capable of capturing complex mass tensors in heterostructures, is combined with Non-equilibrium Green's functions using a self-consistent Born approximation for Coulomb interactions between electrons and holes.

articleTitle: Transient Gas Pinhole Based on Saturated Absorption for High Energy Ultraviolet Lasers
abstract: We propose a novel pinhole design with much higher damage thresholds than traditional pinholes by leveraging the saturated absorption of ultraviolet light in ozone. Compact and robust soft-edge spatial filtering was demonstrated experimentally.© 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: In Situ Lipid Profiling at Submicron Resolution by Hyperspectral Stimulated Raman Imaging
abstract: Achieving high spatial resolution in lipid profiling for life science and biomedical applications has been challenging. Here, we developed a hyperspectral stimulated Raman scattering imaging and analysis method for in situ lipid profiling in single cells and tissues by identifying spectroscopic signatures of chain length and unsaturation levels.

articleTitle: Quasi Phase Matching from Periodically Poled 3R-Stacked Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
abstract: Here we demonstrate broadband quasi phase matching in a periodically poled van der Waals semiconductor <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(3\mathrm{R}-\text{MoS}_{2})$</tex>. This work opens up the new and unexplored field of phase-matched nonlinear optics with microscopic van der Waals crystals.

articleTitle: Fiber-coupled High Numerical Aperture Microlens System: Towards Super-resolution Microscopy Via Photonic Nanojets
abstract: We demonstrate both numerically and experimentally, a path towards super-resolution focusing and imaging through the photonic nanojet technique in a microsphere-microstructure fiber platform.

articleTitle: > 1.5 Octave-broad Optical Frequency Comb for Multi-clock Comparisons and Wide-band Spectral Purity Transfer
abstract: We present a system composed of an Er:laser-based ultra-low-noise frequency comb seeding a custom-designed photonic-crystal fiber with 2nJ pulse energies. A super-continuum is obtained spanning from 650nm to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>. System qualifications will be pre-sented.

articleTitle: Beyond the Parametric Approximation: Pump Depletion, Entanglement and Squeezing in Down-Conversion
abstract: We study the dynamics of the down conversion process in the pump-depleted region using the cumulant expansion method and perturbation theory. We find the time scales associated with pump-mode depletion, squeezing and entanglement.

articleTitle: Fluctuation and Dissipation in Quantum Nonlinear Optics
abstract: We present a new fluctuation-dissipation relation that shows how quantum noise transforms under engineered nonlinear dissipation found in many important nonlinear optical devices and validate the theory with experiments on nonlinear interferometers.

articleTitle: Fluorescence by Nonclassical Light: Getting it Right
abstract: We calculate the fluorescence of cold cesium atoms excited by low intensity, non-degenerate squeezed light, which enhances the fluorescence rate compared to classical light. The signal is predicted to be in an experimentally detectable regime.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic Beam Steerer Based on Metalens Focal Plane Array with Direction Fine-Tuning
abstract: We demonstrate a resolution-enhanced silicon photonic beam steerer that combines coarse steering with a focal plane array and fine-tuning with serpentine microheaters. The steerer allows 3N resolvable points with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$N$</tex> waveguide channels.

articleTitle: High Performance Folded Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Modulators on Quartz Substrate Fabricated by Photolithography
abstract: We report a high-performance folded thin-film lithium-niobate modulator through photolithography. The fabricated modulator exhibits the Vπ of 1.85V and extinction-ratio ~25dB under Pπ ~ 17mW with the smooth EE response and EO bandwidth higher than 67GHz.

articleTitle: Compact and Robust Common-Path Scheme for Fourth Harmonic Generation of Deep UV Ultrashort Laser Pulses
abstract: Ultrashort pulses in the deep-UV region around 200 nm have important applications in laser spectroscopy and Free-Electron laser technology [1], [2]. Such pulses can be obtained using Ti:Sapphire laser followed by a fourth harmonic generation (FHG). In this case due to phase matching limitations of the available nonlinear crystals the fourth harmonic (FH) can only be generated in a three-step setup starting with second harmonic generation (SHG), followed by third harmonic generation (THG) realized by sum frequency mixing (SF) of SH and fundamental pulses, and then a final FHG stage based on sum frequency mixing of third harmonic (TH) and fundamental pulses.

articleTitle: Temperature-Resolved Photoionization Spectroscopy of the Nitrogen–Vacancy ${}^{1}E$ Singlet State
abstract: By applying wavelength-tuned spin-selective photoionization, the energies of the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1E$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1A_{1}$</tex> nitrogen-vacancy (NV) singlet states relative to the diamond band-gap edges are determined as a function of temperature.

articleTitle: Compensation of Scale Factor Error for Open-Loop Fiber Optic Gyroscopes
abstract: Theoretical analysis of the scale factor nonlinearity (SFN) in open-loop fiber optic gyroscopes is conducted. A k-factor compensation method is introduced, effectively reducing SFN to 2.5 ppm over the range of −300 to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$+300^{\circ}/\mathrm{s}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Cavitation-Based Laser Micromachining with Nonstandard Immersion Liquids
abstract: We continue our investigation into the effects of ultrafast laser cavitation-based micromachining using various immersion liquids beyond simple water. Physical properties beyond vapor pressure are considered to contribute to enhancing or suppressing material removal.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Photoelectrochemical Photodetector with High Responsivity and Large Bandwidth for Optical Wireless Communication
abstract: Response speed and responsivity are crucial for photodetectors. GaN nanowires were used to construct fast-response photoelectrochemical photodetectors. Iridium-oxide decoration improved the responsivity and response speed with a demonstration of large-bandwidth optical communication. © 2024 The Author(s) Key words: response speed, responsivity, surface decoration, photo electro chemical photodetectors, optical wireless communication

articleTitle: Weight Clustering for Low-Complexity Time Domain-Based Chromatic Dispersion Compensation in Optical Fiber Links
abstract: We use weight clustering to reduce chromatic dispersion compensation complexity in a 16-QAM transmission across 1280 km of SSMF at 32Gbd. As nonlinearity increases, we observe that fewer clusters are needed to equalize.

articleTitle: Broadband and Tailorable THz Emission from Spintronic Photonic Crystals
abstract: we explore THz generation from structured ferromagnet/ultrawide bandgap semiconductor heterostructures. The emission spectrum can span the entire THz gap, be enhanced, and tuned by changing size and periodicity of the subwavelength pillars in photonic crystal.

articleTitle: Low-Temperature Sputtered Ultralow-Loss Silicon Nitride for Integrated Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate ultralow-loss, high-thickness silicon nitride waveguides and microresonators based on room-temperature sputtering. We reach propagation losses of 3.5 dB/m after 800°C annealing, enabling ring resonators with optical quality factors > 10 million. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: An Anti-Interference Network of CNN-BiGRU for Pipeline Corrosion Recognition with Fiber Optic DAS System
abstract: An anti-interference network of CNN -BiGRU for pipeline corrosion recognition assisted with fiber optic DAS system is proposed. For the recognition of seven corrosion degrees in high-interference environment, the proposed model trained on data from one pipeline, can achieve the average accuracy of 83.4% for other pipelines.

articleTitle: Nonlinearities in Tapered Multi Mode Fibers
abstract: We demonstrate propagation of higher order modes in fiber tapers with negligible intermodal coupling, enabling wavelength control of dispersive wave generation in a single LP0,m mode around 800nm.

articleTitle: Realization of a Dual-Rail Photonic Cluster State
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of a 4-photon, dual-rail cluster state with a lower-bound fidelity of 0.81 consisting of sequences of dual-color photon pairs. Our approach is extendable to general NxM cluster states.

articleTitle: Improved Color Purity with Red-Green-Yellow Quantum Dots and Blue Resonant Cavity Micro-LEDs for High-Resolution Full Color Displays
abstract: Our research presents a 12 μ m RC-μ-LED design using quantum dots for vibrant, full-color displays, overcoming InGaN RGB micro-LEDs' limitations and offering high resolution, brightness, and color accuracy for advanced digital applications.

articleTitle: 50-FS Pulse Generation from a SESAM Mode-Locked Tm,Ho:CALYGO Laser
abstract: Mode-locking of a novel Tm,Ho:CALYGO crystal, exhibiting both structural and compositional disorder, is demonstrated generating 50- fs long pulses at 2078 nm with an average output power of 60 mW at 79.3 MHz.

articleTitle: Impact of AES-CTR Mode Modified QAM Symbol Block Cipher on Nonlinear Fiber-Optic Channels
abstract: In a 7-ch WDM transmission experiment spanning 2240 km with fiber nonlinearity effects, we employed AES-CTR mode corrected symbol block cipher for dual-polarized-QAM, showcasing penalty-free performance irrespective of encryption presence and rendering eavesdropper decryption challenging. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Long-Distance Transmission Using Multi-Mode Fibers
abstract: Space-division multiplexing through multi-mode fibers has been proposed as a solution for the ever-increasing demand for bandwidth. This invited talk addresses how large-mode-count multi-mode fibers can be used for long-distance optical communication.

articleTitle: Machine-Learning-Optimized OAM Excitation in Optical Fibers
abstract: We develop a machine learning algorithm for in situ control and optimization of OAM excitation in optical fibers, ensuring high-purity and low-loss coupling. The algorithm can correct intentional misalignments, as well as compensate alignment drift.

articleTitle: Sub-Terahertz Field-Resolved Detection Using a Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Platform
abstract: We present a new class of thin-film lithium niobate integrated detectors, featuring a millimeter-long sensitive area and capable of performing the off-focus field-resolved reconstruction of sub-terahertz transients.

articleTitle: An Open-Access Platform for Thin Film Lithium Niobate Photonic Integrated Circuits (TFLN PICs)
abstract: We introduce an open, standardized TFLN PICs platform available to PIC designers through a fabless scheme. Several technology steps have been established, providing a reliable process design kit (PDK) in the telecommunication C-band.

articleTitle: Nanodiamonds With Group IV Defects Coupled to Fabry-Perot Resonators
abstract: Using color center in diamond (e.g. silicon vacancy) coupled to an open Fabry-Perot cavity, we present an efficient spin-photon interface. We demonstrate optical coherent driving of a silicon vacancy transition and Purcell enhancement.

articleTitle: Strong Third-Order Nonlinearity in Silicon-Rich Amorphous Silicon Carbide Integrated Platforms
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate efficient four-wave mixing in silicon-rich amorphous silicon carbide waveguides, and characterize its nonlinear refractive index, which is 6.83 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−18</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/W. one order of magnitude higher than crystalline silicon car-bide.

articleTitle: Soliton Pulse Compression in Lithium Niobate Nanophotonics
abstract: We show that soliton pulse compression in lithium niobate nanophotonics can enable formation of few-cycle pulses. We experimentally confirm such nonlinear dynamics and measure chirped 44-fs output pulses consistent with numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Hong-Ou-Mandel Interference with a Diode-Pumped 1-GHz Ti:Sapphire Laser
abstract: We demonstrate correlated photon pair generation at 790 nm using a diode-pumped Kerr-lens-modelocked 1-GHz Ti:sapphire laser and verify the presence of indistinguishable photons using Hong-Ou-Mandel interferometry, showing a dip in coincidence counts with 81.8% visibility. © The Author(s)

articleTitle: Optical Magnetometry Based on Fluidic-Solid Composite WGM Microbubble Resonator
abstract: We demonstrate an AC optical magnetometry based on fluid-solid composite whispering gallery mode microcavity filled with Terfenol-D particles and UV adhesive, achieving the sensitivity of 9.2 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{nT}/\sqrt{\text{Hz}}$</tex> at frequency of 2 MHz.© 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Highly Enhanced Pattern Recognition with a Balanced Joint Transform Correlator
abstract: We describe an opto-electronic balanced joint transform correlator that optimizes the dynamic range of the output spatial light modulator to improve by several orders of magnitude the signal to noise ratio for pattern recognition.

articleTitle: Terahertz Wave Generation by Dual-Wavelength Laser Lights Injection-Locked to a Soliton Microcomb in Mode Spacing of 560 GHz for Wireless Communication with Advanced Modulation Format
abstract: We demonstrate the THz-wave generation using dual wavelength lasers injection-locked to a soliton microcomb and photomixing. We also apply the generated wave to THz wireless communication in 560 GHz band using advanced modulation format.

articleTitle: Moiré Localization Induced Enhancement in the Decoherence Time of Interlayer Excitons in WSe2-MoSe2 Heterobilayers
abstract: We show that prolonged dephasing times can be obtained from the emission of an ensemble of moiré-localized IXs in hBN-encapsulated WSe2-MoSe2 heterobilayers under moderate pump powers, which would be critical for quantum photonics applications. © The Author(s)

articleTitle: Imaging of Standing-Wave Patterns from a Bi-Directionally Pumped Microresonator
abstract: We perform real-time imaging of standing waves in bi-directionally pumped microresonators. This is achieved by collecting scattered light with a short-wave infrared camera. The measurements enable subwavelength distance measurements of scattering sources with nanometer-level accuracy.

articleTitle: Efficient General Waveform Catching by a Cavity at an Absorbing Exceptional Point
abstract: We show that a cavity at an absorbing exceptional point captures additional temporal orders of any incoming waveform, resulting in efficient passive state transfer and photon detection © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Impact of Polarization Direction on Ultrafast Laser Stress Generation in Fused Silica
abstract: Ultrafast laser-generated stress in fused silica, from lines of overlapping spots, depends on the linear polarization and writing directions. We present experimental evidence that this is not solely due to rotation of the nanograting orientation.

articleTitle: Control of Cascaded Four-Wave Mixing via Dynamic Dispersion
abstract: We demonstrate control of cascaded four-wave mixing by programmable dispersion tuning. With modification of only the group delay dispersion (no higher-order terms), we are able to achieve a 250% increase in the spectral bandwidth.

articleTitle: Barium Titanate Racetrack Modulator on Silicon Nitride for 200 GBd Data Communication in the O-band
abstract: We demonstrate the first O-band BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-plasmonic modulator on SiN. Featuring symbol rates of up to 200 GBd, 2 dB on-chip loss, and 70 GHz bandwidth, this approach proves suitable for low-loss, high-speed, and low-complexity communication.

articleTitle: Electrically Programmable Non-Volatile Silicon Photonic Content Addressable Memory (CAM) Cell
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the first electrically programmable, non-volatile silicon photonic content addressable memory cell using Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se3 phase change material on microring resonators, opening the path for light-based search operations in zero-power look-up tables.

articleTitle: Improving Frequency Noise of DFB Fiber Lasers by Acoustic Wave Suppression
abstract: The frequency noise of narrow linewidth fiber l aser c an b e improved by addressing resonant longitudinal acoustic waves in the optical cavity. Comprehensive measurements and simulations of phonon modes aid in understanding and mitigating this phenomenon.

articleTitle: High-Energy Fiber-Delivered Ultrashort Pulses on Demand
abstract: We describe a nonlinear Er:doped fiber amplification scheme for producing fiber-delivered, 44 fs pulses with 100 kW peak power at arbitrary (0–60 MHz) repetition rate. Subsequent spectral broadening produces 80 THz of bandwidth.

articleTitle: Room-Temperature Silicon Nitride Quantum Emitters for Advancing Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: Newly discovered silicon nitride quantum emitters hold great promise for industrial-scale quantum photonic applications. We assess the performance of intrinsic room-temperature SiN single-photon emitters for quantum key distribution, showcasing their exceptional brightness and single-photon purity. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Investigation of Efficient Microwave Control of Unstrained Negatively Charged Group-IV Color Centers in Diamond
abstract: This work theoretically investigates the microwave control of group-IV color centers. We find that heavy vacancies such as the tin and lead vacancy can be efficiently controlled without external strain.

articleTitle: High Density Rydberg Gas Produced by Ultrashort Pulse Excitation and Spontaneous Ionization Induced by Rydberg-Rydberg Interactions
abstract: We realized <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sim 10^{11}\mathrm{c}\mathrm{m}^{-3}$</tex> high density Rydberg gas of ultracold <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb atoms by ultrafast excitation using improved picosecond pulse laser system, and observed the spontaneous ionization induced by Rydberg-Rydberg interactions. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Miniaturized Laser Distribution Module for Compact Sr-Based Optical Atomic Clocks
abstract: We present the layout of a miniaturized laser distribution module as part of a <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">88</sup>Sr optical lattice clock. It consists of distributed Bragg reflector lasers (679 and 707 nm) combined with specifically developed, miniaturized electro-optical components.

articleTitle: Red VCSEL Array for Optical Parallel-Interconnected Links with Ultra-Low Energy Consumption
abstract: We demonstrated a high data rate of 4.7 Gb/s based on a single 650-nm vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser with 2-pJ/bit energy consumption, potentially enabling Tb/s parallel interconnects based on a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$14\times 16$</tex> array.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum Generation via Adiabaticity Shortcut Coupling for High Order Modes in Ta2O5 Waveguides
abstract: In this work, by using adiabatic shortcut directional coupling approach, coupling efficiency over 80% from TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</inf> to TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> mode within Ta<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> nonlinear waveguide was realized. In addition, octave-spanning supercontinuum generation (650nm to 1300nm) has been demonstrated and discussed.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Modeling Dynamic Gain and Nonlinearities in Ultrafast Fiber Amplifiers
abstract: We introduce a deep-learning method for modeling dynamic gain and non-linearities in ultrafast fiber amplifiers, overcoming li mitations of ph ysics-based models. Trained and tested with experiments, the algorithm can predict accurately, adaptable to varying amplifier conditions.

articleTitle: Extended Ambiguity Range in Photonic Stepped-Frequency Radar Systems
abstract: The unambiguity range of photonic stepped frequency radar is inversely determined by the frequency-shifting modulation step, thereby typically being at metre level. Here, we demonstrate a 10-fold unambiguity range extension to 15 metres.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Laser Damage Comparison Between Silica/Hafnia Nanolaminates vs. Mixed Material Coatings for High Power Laser Optics
abstract: Two layer anti-reflection coatings (Air/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/HfSiO/substrate. vs Air/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Hf-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> nanolaminates/substrate) were tested with p-polarized 77 fs 1030 nm laser pulses. Damage threshold fluence of the sample with nanolaminate was ∼ 2/3 of the damage fluence of the mixed layer sample. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultra-Compact Optical Neural Network Chip
abstract: Two diffractive optical neural network chips featuring an integration level of over 60,000 neurons/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> are fabricated, experimentally yielding accuracies of 90.0% and 93.3% on the Iris plants dataset, respectively. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Multicolor Solitons with and Without Phase-Locking
abstract: We report the observation in a fiber laser of a new class of soliton comprised of multiple frequency components with the same group velocity but different propagation constants, which exhibit small periodic pulse-to-pulse energy variations.

articleTitle: OFDR-Based High-Temperature-Resolution Sensing by Using TC-HNA Sensing Fiber and Deep-Learning Denoising
abstract: Combining TC-HNA sensing fiber and a deep-learning denoising technique, a temperature resolution of 0.29 °C on a 50-m fiber with a spatial resolution of 1 mm based on an OFDR system is experimentally achieved.

articleTitle: Multi-Junction Type Large-Aperture High-Speed PIN-PD and its Characteristics for Optical Wireless Communications
abstract: We propose a multi-junction type large-aperture PIN photodetectors for high-speed optical wireless communication. A tradeoff solution between a large PD and high 3-dB bandwidth was proposed and experimentally confirmed.

articleTitle: Chip Scale Bonding For Heterogeneous Integration of Lithium Niobate on Low Loss Passive Silicon Nitride
abstract: We demonstrate chip-scale heterogeneous integration of lithium niobate on low loss silicon nitride microrings and measure a loss of 1.07 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm$</tex> 0.05 dB/mm for the hybrid mode. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Nonlinearity-Controlled Non-Hermitian Topological Phase Transitions
abstract: We observe nonlinearity-driven fast NH phase transitions in a photonic Floquet topological insulator on a silicon chip. Light that was in a forbidden bandgap can now be transported along a topological gain-loss junction at which a nonlinearity-controlled NH phase transition occurs.

articleTitle: Polaritons and Nanophotonics Applications in Earth-Abundant Layered Materials
abstract: We provide an overview for studying nano-optics of 2D natural phyllosilicates and briefly update applications that combine natural minerals, graphene, and phyllosilicate layers into functional heterostructures. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Stable Frequency Transmission over a 68-km Installed Telecom Fiber Network
abstract: We demonstrate a stable frequency transmission over a 68 km installed tele-com fiber and compare the effect of occasional vibrations within a city on the frequency instability of the system.

articleTitle: Watt-Level Diode-Pumped Tm:CALGO Laser at 2.31 µm
abstract: A diode-pumped continuous-wave 1.5 at.% Tm:CALGO laser operating on the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>→<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> transition generated 1.44 W at 2284-2348 nm with a linear laser polarization (σ). The relevant spectroscopic properties of this material were also determined.

articleTitle: Stochastic Approach in Thermodynamics of Nonlinear Multimode Lattices
abstract: We develop a stochastic Langevin type of approach for thermodynamics of weakly nonlinear multimode optical systems. Our analytical theory captures the complex system-bath dynamics, based on the mixing that caused by optical nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Spontaneously Squeezing Superradiant Laser
abstract: We investigate a superradiant lasing system with atom-atom interaction. We find that this interaction induces a squeezed lasing phase, demonstrating the importance of coherent many-body interactions in lasing.

articleTitle: All-Attosecond Pump-Probe Spectroscopy at kHz Repetition Rate
abstract: Attosecond-pump attosecond-probe spectroscopy (APAPS) promises novel insights into extremely fast electronic dynamics. Here we present a compact realization of APAPS at kHz repetition rate, providing a high stability and good statistics.

articleTitle: Thermal Shock Resistant Optical Packaging of Thin Film Lithium Niobate Devices for Cryogenic Operation
abstract: We present an optically packaged thin film lithium niobate device. We show that this packaged device is capable of cryogenic operation and is resistant to extreme thermal shock.

articleTitle: Quantum-Enhanced Microscopy Using Electron Number Pulses
abstract: We propose a quantum phase estimation protocol in electron microscopy and holography, breaking the shot-noise limit despite the intrinsic Poisson-statistics of electron sources. This surprising capability is enabled by non-destructive measurements heralding number-state electron pulses.

articleTitle: Fully-Integrated Silicon Wavelength Converter with on-Chip Idler Filtering
abstract: We demonstrate a fully-integrated silicon wavelength converter utilizing four-wave mixing, featuring tunable idler filtering with >59 dB out-of-band signal suppression. Conversion of a 32-Gbaud 16-QAM signal with around 2 dB power penalty is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical Input - Optical Output Logic Gates Using Ring Modulator and Photovoltaic Diodes
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate optical input - optical output logic gates using ring modulators and bias-less stacked photodiodes operating in the photovoltaic mode. The proposed structure is implemented in a commercial silicon photonics foundry. © 2024 The Author(s) OCIS codes: (250.5300) Photonic Integrated Circuits; (130.3750) Optical logic devices; (230.1150) All-optical devices; (250.3140) Integrated optoelectronic circuits; (130.4110) Modulators; (230.5160) Photodetectors.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Mode Stabilization of Full-Poincaré Beams in Atmospheric Turbulence
abstract: We discuss a regime of stable nonlinear propagation of a high-powered laser beam with a full-Poincaré polarization structure through atmospheric turbulence, enabling higher power transfer to distant localized areas.

articleTitle: Rotatum of Light
abstract: We introduce optical rotatum where a vortex beam experiences a quadratic chirp in its orbital angular momentum along the optical path. We discuss the physical dynamics of this topological deformation as well as potential use in metrology and sensing.

articleTitle: Fiber-Interferometric Second Harmonic Generator for Dual-Color Standard Quantum-Limited Noise Suppression
abstract: We present a novel fiber-interferometric mechanism that employs controlled nonlinear polarization rotation in interaction with type-I phase matched SHG to generate dual-color optical pulse trains (515/1030 nm) with concurrent> 14 dB standard-quantum limited noise suppression.

articleTitle: Towards Spatially Resolved, Single-Ended Tunable Diode Laser Absorption Spectroscopy in Particle-Laden Flows
abstract: This study introduces a novel technique for single-ended measurements of the properties of inhomogeneous particle-laden gases by combining tunable-diode laser absorption spectroscopy with optical ranging. The technique and evaluation strategy are demonstrated with a numerical study.

articleTitle: Super-Resolution of Optical Thickness Measurement Employing Correlation-Based Spectrum Estimation
abstract: The quantification of optical thickness using a wavelength swept source is pivotal for applications such as Swept Source Optical Coherence Tomography (SS-OCT) and Frequency-Modulated Continuous-Wave (FMCW) lidar, demanding sub-millimeter range resolution. To enhance resolution, we advocate the incorporation of a correlation-based spectrum estimation method in FMCW optical thickness measurement. Our approach successfully resolved a notable 0.59 mm of thickness with a 1.7 nm wavelength sweep, surpassing the 0.61 mm theoretical limit imposed by Fourier transform.

articleTitle: Transmission in a Field-Deployed Multimode Fiber Cable
abstract: In this invited paper, we review our recent results for mode-division-multiplexed transmission over subsets of spatial modes in a field-deployed 15-mode fiber cable, and analysis of impulse responses from individual fiber strands in the cable.

articleTitle: Integration of Metasurface and PCSEL in Real-Time Depth-Sensing Micro-System for Facial Recognition
abstract: We demonstrate a novel dot projector architecture for depth-sensing perception facial recognition applying metasurfaces and photonic crystal surface-emitting lasers (PCSELs), which has area 55 times smaller and power-consumption 5~10 times lower than commercial dot projector.

articleTitle: Hybrid Integrated GaSb/Si3N4 DBR Lasers with >30 mW Output Power and >50 nm Wavelength Coverage
abstract: We demonstrate hybrid integrated lasers based on a GaSb-based gain chip coupled to a silicon nitride photonic integrated circuit containing Bragg grating posts. The lasers exhibit output power >30 mW and >50 nm wavelength coverage.

articleTitle: When does Interferometric Imaging Achieve Superresolution?
abstract: Multi-aperture imaging is often said to enable equivalent spatial resolution to a single aperture spanning the interferometric baseline. We quantitatively evaluate this statement and identify conditions when interferometry achieves functional superresolution compared to monolithic imaging.

articleTitle: Threshold Quantum State Tomography
abstract: We introduce a new approach to quantum state tomography (QST) in which the number of measurements can be dramatically smaller than in traditional QST without compromising fidelity. We show experimental results up to 7 qubits.

articleTitle: Fractal Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detector Coupled with Multi-Mode Optical Fiber
abstract: Optical absorptance of fractal SNSPDs is insensitive to the speckles in multi-mode fiber (MMF). We demonstrate 73% system detection efficiency at 1540 nm and 69 ps timing jitter with a MMF-coupled fractal SNSPD.

articleTitle: Optimized Photonic Integrated Circuit Components for Optical Coherence Tomography at 1060 nm
abstract: To implement optical coherence tomography on photonic chips, we developed optimized and experimentally validated silicon nitride-based components for photonic integrated circuits in order to achieve high sensitivity and axial resolution for OCT at 1060 nm.

articleTitle: Monolithically Integrated Tunable Inductive Termination for Equalizing Traveling-Wave Mach-Zehnder Modulators
abstract: Silicon traveling-wave Mach-Zehnder modulators are monolithically integrated with tunable inductive terminations for low-power, variable equalization circuits. Equalizing subthreshold forward-biased modulators doubled EO bandwidth for 56 Gbit/s transmission below KP4-FEC thresholds while consuming 360 fJ/bit.

articleTitle: Analytical Study on Slow-Light Orbital Angular Momentum Beams in Vertical Photonic Crystal Waveguides for Gas Detection
abstract: We introduce 2D hexagonal air-hole lattice vertical photonic crystal waveguides (VPCWs) to generate orbital angular momentum beams carrying the slow-light effect for on-chip gas sensing through photonic absorption spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Wide Waveguide Concatenated Euler Bends for Compact and Fabrication Error-Tolerant Pseudo-Single Mode Silicon Photonics
abstract: We propose novel wide waveguide bends for compact, fabrication error-tolerant silicon photonics. They experimentally show ultrasmall bend loss < 0.005 dB/bend with an 8-um radius. Their 10×10 interferometers show a fidelity of 0.979 without calibration.

articleTitle: Networked Multi-User Continuous-Variable Quantum Key Distribution Using Squeezed State
abstract: We report a continuous-variable quantum key distribution protocol with high resistance to channel loss and excess noise by using a squeezed state source and multiple homodyne detectors.

articleTitle: Desensitizing Self-Trapped Excitonic Emission in Bi-Ho Co-Doped Cs2AgInCl6 Nanocrystals
abstract: Under the excitation of 370 nm, the photophysics of Bi-Ho co-doped double perovskite nanocrystals is revealed here. Temperature-dependent photoluminescence has been studied to explore their self-trapped exciton and exciton-phonon coupling properties.

articleTitle: 61.3% Efficiency of Second Harmonic Generation in a Lithium Niobate Microresonator
abstract: We demonstrate the second harmonic generation process with a record ef-ficiency of 61.3%, benefiting from the generalized critical coupling condition. Besides, a dichromatic pump-probe method is proposed for real-time phase-matching monitoring. © The Author(s)

articleTitle: Two-Photon Lithography Assisted Fluorescence Sensor for Sensitive Detection of Lead Ions in Water
abstract: We report the fabrication of a miniaturized sensor by femtosecond laser-assisted two-photon lithography for the sensitive detection of Lead in water. Fluorescence turn-off or quenching was achieved at ppb levels.

articleTitle: Symmetry Breaking of the $\chi^{(2)}$ Polarization in Poled Thin Film Lithium Niobate Waveguides Enabling Phase Matching
abstract: Poling the bottom of etched LNOI waveguides enables modal phase matching with an anti-symmetric mode and a measured second harmonic generation efficiency of 1980 %W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup>. The simple design allows for reproducible on-chip frequency conversion.

articleTitle: Current Injection Laser Oscillation of 1.55 μm InAs Quantum Dot Vertical-Cavity Surface-Emitting Lasers
abstract: We have successfully demonstrated, for the first time, current injection laser oscillation in a 1.55 μm VCSEL using InAs quantum dot active layers grown on an InP(311)B substrate.

articleTitle: Experimental Characterization and Modeling of Sub-Nanosecond Fe: ZnSe Mid-IR Gain-Switched Laser Operating at Room Temperature
abstract: We report on the experimental characterization and modeling of sub-nanosecond Fe: ZnSe mid-IR gain-switched laser operating at room temperature. A single-spike oscillation with an output energy of 0.33 mJ was achieved under 4.67 mJ pump energy.

articleTitle: Low-Threshold Single Ternary GaAsSb Nanowire Lasers Emitting at Silicon Transparent Wavelengths
abstract: We demonstrate lasing from single ternary GaAsSb nanowire (NW) lasers with low threshold under optical pumping at silicon transparent wavelengths (~1.1-1.2 µm). These breakthroughs are enabled by combining high-quality, phase-pure GaAsSb NWs with extended cavity lengths and effective surface passivation using lattice-matched InAlGaAs layers. Lasing at thresholds of ~ 3 µJ/cm2 and up to 250 K is verified.

articleTitle: Integrating Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Photonics and Surface-Electrode Ion Traps
abstract: Integrated photonics offers trapped-ion experiments scalable performance ad-vantages and opportunities for monolithic optical control. We present plans for adding thin-film lithium niobate to the trapped-ion photonics toolkit, enabling on-chip modulator inte-gration.

articleTitle: Modeling and Optimization of Interband Cascade Laser AM Frequency Combs
abstract: The effect of group velocity dispersion, intraband relaxation, and nonradiative recombination on AM frequency combs produced by mid-IR interband cascade lasers with optimized two-section (gain and saturable absorber) cavities is analyzed using a detailed numerical model.

articleTitle: Demonstration and Analysis of the Very First Mid-Infrared Sub-mW Threshold Brillouin Laser
abstract: We demonstrate and analyze the first mid-infrared on-chip Brillouin laser generated using chalcogenide resonators. Q-factor of 2.91 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup>, phonon gain bandwidth of 14.51 MHz and threshold power of 93.3 μW were measured.

articleTitle: High Density, Broadband Vertical Optical Interconnects for Passive Assembly
abstract: A chip-to-interposer coupler between silicon nitride and silicon was experimentally demonstrated between 1480–1640 nm with a coupling loss upper limit of -2.3 ± 1 dB and a 1 dB alignment tolerance of 1.12 ± 0.23 μm.

articleTitle: Enhancement of TMD Exciton Resonances Using Plasmonic Resonators
abstract: Samples of monolayer, bilayer, trilayer and 4-layer WS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> encapsulated between two layers of hBN are embedded into plasmonic patch antennas. The resulting low mode volume leads to 1000-fold enhancement of dark resonances in the material

articleTitle: Photonic Quantum Extreme Reservoir Computation
abstract: Quantum extreme reservoir computation is a resource-efficient quantum neural-network model that combines the concepts of extreme machine learning with quantum reservoir computation for classification tasks. We propose a few-photon implementation that achieves remarkably high accuracy.

articleTitle: Deterministic Vortices Evolving from Partially Coherent Fields
abstract: It has long been believed that there is an intrinsic conflict between vortices and partial coherence. However, we demonstrate that a partially coherent beam can be designed, through the use of fractional Fourier transforms (FracFTs), to manifest a deterministic vortex at any range and for any degree of spatial coherence in the source plane.

articleTitle: Breaking the Limitation between Ranging/Velocity Resolution and Voxel Rate by Coherent Stitching in a Dual-comb Lidar
abstract: We propose a coherent stitching method by exploring the coherence in different beat notes in a dual-comb Lidar. An equivalent sweeping bandwidth of 70 GHz and a voxel rate of 100 kHz are achieved.

articleTitle: Towards Multi-Pbps Backbone Optical Networks in Support of Future 6G Networks
abstract: We describe innovative concepts associated with optical switching nodes and their transceiver interfaces that enable energy-efficient flexible capacity scaling (>10 Tb/s per interface, > 1Pb/s capacity per link and > 10 Pb/s throughput per node).

articleTitle: Quantum Network Component Development on the 4H-Silicon-Carbide-on-Insulator Platform
abstract: We present our progress toward the integration of various components needed for a quantum network node on the 4H silicon carbide on insulator photonic platform, including defects in waveguides, photonic filters, and waveguide integrated detectors. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ge2Sb2Se4 Te-Based Reconfigurable On-Chip Metasurface NIR Filter
